races.race_name: Coral Chesterfield Cup Handicap

runners.name: Al Aali
runners.spotlight: Had sunk markedly in the weights before first-time blinkers saw him take a six-runner race at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) 11 days ago in clearcut fashion, coming from last for his first win since a 2yo; back up 5lb but maybe he's turned a corner in the headgear.
runners.comment: Won in first blinkers at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) 11 days ago, coming from last of 6

runners.name: Yabher
runners.spotlight: Acts on good to firm; effective with varied tactics and easily made all on his reappearance over C&D (good; 10lb higher today) in May; needs to bounce back from a poor show when never dangerous at just 7-1 for a top 1m2f handicap at York 17 days ago.
runners.comment: Easily made all over C&D (good; 10lb higher now) before poor show in a top York handicap

runners.name: Quai De Bethune
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo for Andrew Balding in the first half of last year, culminating in a 1m2f handicap win at Royal Ascot (good to firm); sold for 775,000gns the following month but not seen again until well held in major 1m2f handicaps this summer at Epsom and York; hooded in the latter when getting hampered over 1f out contributed but he did not look like playing a major part at the time; player if surging back to his best.
runners.comment: 1m2f handicap win at 2025 Royal Ascot; 775,000gns buy but well held both runs this summer

runners.name: Twisting Physics
runners.spotlight: Made an eye-catching reappearance from well off the pace in April and went mighty close when he reverted to front-running over that same Newbury 1m2f (good) in June; tongue tied first time in the latter and again on latest start when always prominent to prevail by a neck in something of a bunched finish at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm); a different 5lb claimer takes over today; back up 2lb but looks an each-way player.
runners.comment: Won by a neck in something of a bunched finish at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm); e-w player

runners.name: Rathgar
runners.spotlight: Has won twice at this track, albeit in very different races to this; 1m2f wins at Newbury and Epsom (made all) on good ground in April and ran well again when third at Sandown this month on good to firm; each-way player if he's in the same form.
runners.comment: Never better than this season and he's an each-way player if in the same form

runners.name: Parole d'Oro
runners.spotlight: 0-8 in handicaps but runner-up in three (two at 1m2f) and ran respectably when fourth at Newmarket on latest start; short of room when well held at this meeting last year; new cheekpieces join the tongue-tie.
runners.comment: 0-8 in handicaps but runner-up in three (two at 1m2f); new cheekpieces join the tongue-tie

runners.name: Noble Horizon
runners.spotlight: 1-8 for William Haggas; second run for new connections when he resumed improvement to make all in ten-runner race at Leicester (1m2f, good; acts on good to firm) in June, well clear through the final 2f; those wins are two of the four times he's made the running, which will be more difficult in this larger field and after a 10lb rise but he looked good last time.
runners.comment: Second run for yard when making all at Leicester (1m2f; ten ran), well clear; up 10lb

runners.name: Wave Rider
runners.spotlight: Ended his time with Harry Charlton on a high for Pontefract win (1m2f, good to soft; has won on good to firm) last September; had three races in Bahrain in December-March, clearly best of those on first occasion and given wind surgery since latest; needs a career best.
runners.comment: Three races in Bahrain in December-March, clearly best of those on first occasion; wind op

runners.name: Diego El Queso
runners.spotlight: Improvement in each of his three races this term; strong finishes when winning at Leopardstown (1m2f, yielding to soft) on second occasion and second of 11 there (1m1f, good; unraced on firmer) on latest, so it's not hard to believe that he remains capable of better; greatly respected.
runners.comment: Improvement in each race this term; strong finishes and he could easily still do better

runners.name: Night Breeze
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in 2024 on his only appearance at this track; reliable sort who hit new heights over 1m4f on last three outings, so this drop back in trip asks a question but he needs respect.
runners.comment: Reliable sort who hit new heights last three races, over 1m4f admittedly but needs respect

runners.name: Liberty Lane
runners.spotlight: The first of two Listed wins last year came over C&D; out of form this season until respectable fifth of 14 in handicap at Sandown (1m) latest outing, when wearing first headgear (retained today); needs to build on that.
runners.comment: C&D Listed winner last term; out of form this season until first headgear on latest start
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Henlein
runners.spotlight: Close second in 1m2f Group 1 in 2024 was the peak of his career in Australia; lightly raced since and absent 420 days before his respectable seventh of 12 at 40-1 in Haydock handicap (7f) on British debut; well held at 80-1 in 1m Royal Hunt Cup at Ascot six weeks ago; dropped 5lb on the strength of those last two runs but this return to 1m2f needs to see a return to peak form.
runners.comment: This return to 1m2f (after 7f/1m) needs to see a return to peak Australian form
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Tony Montana
runners.spotlight: Beaten on his last 13 starts going back to May 2024 but he's run some big races and wasn't discredited in his two starts this term; third and tenth in the last two runnings of this race; claimer ridden for the first time as a handicapper and worth a second look despite wide draw.
runners.comment: Beaten on his last 13 starts but he's run some big races; 7lb claimer enlisted; wide draw

runners.name: King's Code
runners.spotlight: Took form to a new level on AW early this year, which he's not repeated but winning at Chester (1m2f, good) 18 days ago was a return to his best turf form; back up 3lb today, well held in this race two years ago (his only handicap here) and he also has more to prove on ground firmer than good.
runners.comment: Chester win (1m2f, good) 18 days ago was a return to his best turf form; back up 3lb

runners.name: Bolster
runners.spotlight: Used to represent same connections as Liberty Lane but performed near his best only a couple of times last season, including when a promoted fourth in this race (good); had gelding and wind operations before well beaten on reappearance in June in first-time headgear; sold for 35,000gns 19 days ago; one of his handicap wins was on good to soft and the other three were on soft, neither of which is likely today.
runners.comment: Ex-Karl Burke; well beaten in June in first-time headgear; sold for 35,000gns 19 days ago

runners.name: Dhahabi
runners.spotlight: Ended his time with Charlie Appleby on a low note (March 2024) and no revival in his four races at Meydan for another yard the following winter; 483 days off and switched stables again before well beaten at Epsom (1m2f, good to soft; 100-1) early last month, which has been followed by another 5lb fall but he's hard to latch on to at the moment.
runners.comment: Out of form in last six races, for three yards; 483 days off before his only run this term

runners.name: Torito
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since winning twice on turf as a 3yo; while not at his best last season, he was still third to Liberty Lane in a 1m2f Listed race in November and isn't entirely dismissed reappearing in new headgear (replacing recent cheekpieces) for his first handicap since May 2024.
runners.comment: Not entirely dismissed reappearing in new headgear for his first handicap since May 2024

races.race_name: Coral Vintage Stakes (Group 2)

runners.name: Al Hudaiba
runners.spotlight: Looks rather quirky having jinked right in two of his races, unseating rider on first occasion; however, once straightening he knuckled down well in the Group 2 Superlative Stakes at Newmarket (7f, good to firm; got up in final stride) latest, taking record in completed starts to 3-3; now goes in headgear, which may prove beneficial; leading player, even with 3lb penalty.
runners.comment: Looks quirky but is 3-3 in completed runs, bagging the Superlative latest; headgear fitted

runners.name: Pikachu
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who is the only maiden in this field but is a useful one, having performed well in the Chesham and the Superlative; about only 1l behind Al Hudaiba at Newmarket and now gets a 3lb pull with that rival; first success is not out of the question.
runners.comment: 0-3 but is a useful sort; ties in closely with Al Hudaiba on Superlative Stakes form

runners.name: Haffner
runners.spotlight: Made a promising debut behind stablemate Abraham Lincoln, who nearly beat Al Hudaiba in the Superlative Stakes next time; subsequently made all in a traditionally strong maiden (7f, good to firm) on that Newmarket card; looks a Group colt in the making and commands respect with further improvement on the cards.
runners.comment: Made all in a traditionally strong maiden at Newmarket last time; Group colt in the making

runners.name: Ruler's Control
runners.spotlight: Held on narrowly in 5f maiden at the Curragh for Jack Foley, then ran well over 6f in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (good to firm); may do better still in the right circumstances but doesn't give the impression he's crying out for today's 7f trip; tongue-tie applied.
runners.comment: Ran well over 6f in the Windsor Castle but perhaps isn't crying out for 7f

runners.name: Dr Rascal
runners.spotlight: Got loose beforehand but made all and won going away at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last time, taking record to 2-2; brings potential to this higher grade and represents the Cole yard that landed this prize a few times when Paul was at the helm; adds interest.
runners.comment: Made all at Ascot last time, taking record to 2-2; brings potential and adds interest

runners.name: Undiscovered
runners.spotlight: Two from two, justifying odds of 5-6 at Salisbury both times; did it in clearcut fashion upped to 7f (good to firm) latest, albeit helped by main market rival failing to show his form; goes into deeper waters but his limitations are not yet confirmed; similar profile to Dr Rascal.
runners.comment: Scored in clearcut style to complete a Salisbury double; limitations not yet exposed

races.race_name: HKJC World Pool Lennox Stakes (Group 2)

runners.name: Lake Forest
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to impressive win at Haydock (7f Listed) and respectable fifth at Royal Ascot (6f Group 1) this season; fared best of the runners from off the pace when second to Witness Stand in this contest 12 months ago; top on ratings in this bid to go one better.
runners.comment: Best of the runners from off the pace when second in this race last year; top on ratings

runners.name: Marvelman
runners.spotlight: Creditable second, conceding weight all round, in 6f AW Group 3 at Newcastle latest start; readily bagged Group 2 honours at Doncaster on last attempt over 7f on home soil and may be capable of further progress at this distance; one of the main contenders.
runners.comment: Readily bagged Group 2 at Doncaster on last attempt over 7f on home soil; major player

runners.name: Rogue Diplomat
runners.spotlight: Progressive handicapper who landed the Hunt Cup from favourable draw at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) most recently; faces a stiffer task on these terms but possibly hasn't reached his ceiling yet and a strike-rate of 5-6 over 7f bodes well.
runners.comment: Progressive handicapper who landed the Royal Hunt Cup most recently; 5-6 over 7f

runners.name: Holguin
runners.spotlight: Came up short (fourth of six) in this race three years ago and record suggests he's best suited by Listed level; latest effort, in a Chester contest that he'd won twice previously, confirms as much.
runners.comment: Came up short in this race three years ago and seems best suited by Listed level

runners.name: Poet Master
runners.spotlight: Still useful but has failed to back up the form of his Irish Group 2 success two years ago and finished behind some of today's rivals in last three outings; losing sequence looks set to be extended.
runners.comment: Behind some of today's rivals in last three runs; losing sequence should continue
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Qirat
runners.spotlight: Prevailed in Group 3 event at York (7f, good) last time, bouncing back to form with tongue-tie fitted (retained today) and dropped back in trip; record of 3-3 at Goodwood features a success when pacemaker in last year's Sussex Stakes; commands respect returned to this venue.
runners.comment: Bounced back to form last time; record of 3-3 at Goodwood features Sussex Stakes success

runners.name: Lord Britain
runners.spotlight: Has progressive AW form, notably winning twice at Kempton; possibly flattered by his bare figure when rank outsider in Group 1 at Royal Ascot last time; in any case, needs to find further improvement.
runners.comment: Possibly flattered last time; in any case, needs to show further improvement

runners.name: Witness Stand
runners.spotlight: Best effort this year when going close in Group 3 at Epsom on penultimate start; record at Goodwood features two wins at this meeting, including in this race 12 months ago, and a good second to Qirat on worse terms in a handicap; shortlist material back here.
runners.comment: Successful twice at this meeting, including in this contest 12 months ago; should go well

races.race_name: Al Shaqab Goodwood Cup Stakes (Group 1)

runners.name: Scandinavia
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten with cheekpieces added for his last six starts, including this race last year (outbattled an in-form Illinois), the St Leger at Doncaster (by a neck from Rahiebb) that September and last month's 2m4f Gold Cup at Royal Ascot; had proven fitness on his side against the reappearing Trawlerman when inching ahead close home in their magnificent duel for the Gold Cup, but his stayers' crown is unlikely to be relinquished without a mighty effort whatever the circumstances.
runners.comment: 6-6 with cheekpieces, including by a head from Trawlerman last time in Gold Cup at Ascot
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Trawlerman
runners.spotlight: Can make the running (he doesn't have to) to maximise the emphasis on stamina; won a handicap at this meeting in 2022 in his only appearance at Goodwood and has battled it out in the top staying contests since autumn 2023; unbeaten in four British races last season, but reappearance this term was delayed until his repeat bid for the Gold Cup at Royal Ascot and he lost out to Scandinavia in only the dying strides; he didn't look far off his best that day but there's clearly an argument that he will have come on from the run.
runners.comment: Reappearance delayed until repeat bid for Gold Cup and he lost to Scandinavia by a head

runners.name: Rahiebb
runners.spotlight: Two clashes with Scandinavia last term (Royal Ascot and the St Leger) indicated there was little between them and he returned with an authoritative win in the Yorkshire Cup at York in May; all three of those races were over about 1m6f and, having turned for home in fourth when 8-1 in the 2m4f Gold Cup at Royal Ascot, he ended up beaten 24l in eighth; now tries his hand at 2m and maybe he'll get it, but others have proved their stamina.
runners.comment: Has done well at 1m6f and cracked in the straight when 8-1 for the 2m4f Gold Cup at Ascot

runners.name: Lazy Griff
runners.spotlight: Second last term in the Derby and third in the Irish Derby; not seen afterwards as a 3yo but 2m races at Sandown this season have seen his promise renewed for serious stamina tests; it was just a four-runner Listed race last time when he dominated from the front at 4-7, so he needs much better today, but cheekpieces are enlisted and he's a fascinating newcomer to a top staying race.
runners.comment: Placed in Derby and Irish Derby; 2m Listed winner, promise renewed for major stamina tests

runners.name: Amiloc
runners.spotlight: Two wins here in May initiated his tremendous progress last season; flopped at odds-on when he was rather forced to make the running in Yorkshire Cup on 2026 reappearance, but he ran on nicely for a creditable sixth of 12 in a very strong Hardwicke at Royal Ascot (1m4f) next time; stays 1m6f and has each-way claims if he gets this new trip.
runners.comment: Looked back to form latest (1m4f); stays 1m6f and each-way claims if he gets this new trip

runners.name: Miss Alpilles
runners.spotlight: Suited by step up to 2m when Listed winner on final start last term and she's played creditable supporting roles in Group events this term; best form when 11l fifth at 80-1 behind Scandinavia and Trawlerman in the 2m4f Gold Cup at Royal Ascot last time; needs to find extra and headgear is given a go.
runners.comment: Best form when 11l fifth in the Gold Cup; needs to find extra and headgear is given a go

runners.name: French Master
runners.spotlight: Smart performer on his day, as when a 1m6f handicap winner at 2025 Royal Ascot and again on two of three starts this season; beaten a neck by Illinois in 2m5f Queen Alexandra back at Royal Ascot on latest; however, he managed only fifth in this race last year and this renewal also looks tough.
runners.comment: Smart performer on his day; fifth in this race last year and this renewal also looks tough

runners.name: Illinois
runners.spotlight: 7l second to Trawlerman in 2025 Gold Cup at Royal Ascot and beaten three-quarters of a length by Scandinavia in this; those performances were near his best but most since have been pretty grim; this season's clear exception was when he made class tell with sights lowered in the 2m5f Queen Alexandra at Royal Ascot, winning by a neck from French Master, but latest start showed again that today's task is likely to take him well out of his comfort zone.
runners.comment: Second in this last year; unlikely he's the same force now, despite 2m5f Royal Ascot win
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

races.race_name: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap

runners.name: Lexington Blitz
runners.spotlight: Progressive front-runner who was denied late on in the Dash at Epsom (5f, good to soft; has won on good to firm) in early June; he'll give backers a run for their money but could again be picked off where it matters.
runners.comment: Front-runner, narrowly denied in the Dash last time; might get picked off once more

runners.name: Ziggy's Triton
runners.spotlight: Made the most of a drop in grade to edge home in a Class 4 at York 18 days ago (5f, good to firm) and went up only 3lb for that; however, he's by no means certain to repeat that effort and he lacks course experience.
runners.comment: Not certain to repeat his York winning form and he lacks course experience

runners.name: Regal Envoy
runners.spotlight: Has added to his impressive tally with two further 5f wins this season but recent defeats suggest others might be on kinder marks.
runners.comment: Multiple winner but recent defeats suggest others might be on kinder marks

runners.name: Naana's Sparkle
runners.spotlight: Last season went well and so too this current campaign for new trainer with 5f wins on good to soft (handles faster) and Tapeta; may not have reached his ceiling just yet and has been third and first in his two runs here.
runners.comment: Progressive sprinter who has been third and first in his two  runs here

runners.name: Desert Cop
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run in a Class 4 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month but only fourth of seven when penalised at Epsom; well beaten in his two visits here.
runners.comment: A recent Windsor winner but more needed now and he hasn't shone here in the past

runners.name: Rapper's Delight
runners.spotlight: Novice winner who is threatening to win his first handicap having been denied narrowly this month by Naana's Sparkle and Twilight Calls; a late bump didn't help his cause last time at Newmarket and the visor (on for last three races) is working well; possibilities.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied this month in races won by Naana's Sparkle and Twilight Calls

runners.name: Dyonisos
runners.spotlight: Ex-French; didn't get the best of runs when pipped by Seven Questions here in May and overcame some bother in running to go one better at Doncaster last time (5f, good to firm); 4lb rise is fair and this sort of race should suit his style.
runners.comment: Needs luck in running if ridden for cover but the ability is there to deal with this mark

runners.name: Spring Is Sprung
runners.spotlight: Played his part in a strong pace last time at York yet hung around to finish a half-length behind winner Ziggy's Triton; has little margin for error off this mark and other pace influences temper enthusiasm.
runners.comment: Little margin for error off this mark and other pace influences temper enthusiasm

runners.name: Candy
runners.spotlight: All wins over 6f (on soft and good ground) and he's 0-5 at 5f; can lead; 5lb higher than when winning the Ayr Silver Cup (soft) last September but Jack Callan claims 3lb and forget Ascot last month as he banged his head on the stalls; however, at this trip others are preferred.
runners.comment: All wins at 6f; Ayr Silver Cup winner; forget Ascot latest as he banged his head on stalls

runners.name: Toca Madera
runners.spotlight: Came good off a reduced mark at Doncaster in June (5f, good to firm) but two lesser efforts have followed and this is a tough race in which to bounce back.
runners.comment: Doncaster winner in early June but two lesser efforts have followed
runners.owner: L Bond & Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi

runners.name: Twilight Calls
runners.spotlight: Classy sprinter back in the day and the new visor has been floating his boat with recent form figures of 121 in 5f handicaps, latterly getting up in the nick of time at Newmarket; only 3lb higher and this hold-up performer should have this run to suit; finished fifth in last year's Stewards' Cup, faring best in his group; firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: The new visor has been floating his boat with recent form figures of 121 in 5f handicaps

runners.name: Glamorous Breeze
runners.spotlight: An 8yo mare but as good as ever and close up in 5f handicaps this season at this track, Windsor and Ascot; in the mix.
runners.comment: An 8yo mare but as good as ever and close up in 5f handicaps this season

runners.name: Tatterstall
runners.spotlight: Yet another prominent racer; in good form since returning from a break but appeared to be beaten fair and square behind some of these at Newmarket's July meeting.
runners.comment: Appeared to be beaten fair and square behind some of these at Newmarket's July meeting

runners.name: Adrestia
runners.spotlight: Royal Ascot handicap winner last year (5f, good to firm) and later went close in this race when 3lb higher; yet to get competitive this term but could have needed the comeback run, there were blindfold issues next time and she ran well for a long way at Ascot 17 days ago before eased considerably late on; drawn next to the stands' rail and a revival is not out of the question with form figures of 132 under the returning Oisin Murphy; tongue tied last two races.
runners.comment: Nearly won this last year off 3lb higher; revival on the cards with Murphy back aboard

runners.name: Seven Questions
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in the last two editions of the Stewards' Cup here but won from off the pace over C&D in May, leading on the line under a Jamie Spencer masterclass; barely sighted in his two subsequent runs (soft/AW; ridden more prominently) but, back in this scenario with a strong pace guaranteed, he could easily be a factor if reverting to patient tactics.
runners.comment: Back in this scenario with a strong pace guaranteed, he's dangerous to dismiss

runners.name: Germanic
runners.spotlight: All three wins and best form have been on the AW, delivering a career high at Newcastle in January (5f AW); lower turf mark sees him 2lb higher here but he is 0-11 on grass and lacks a recent run.
runners.comment: Three AW wins but he's 0-11 on grass and lacks a recent run

runners.name: Exclamation
runners.spotlight: Made all at Chester this spring and always prominent when narrowly denied in a small field at Sandown latest (5f, good; second run in cheekpieces); probably worth taking on, with consistency not his forte.
runners.comment: Capable sprinter but probably worth taking on, with consistency not his forte

runners.name: The Man
runners.spotlight: Back from a break and wind surgery when impressive in a big field at York in May 2024 (5f, good to firm; 7lb lower); however, failed to fire at Meydan this year and was again down the field at Newcastle a month ago; cheekpieces replace a hood.
runners.comment: 7lb higher than for his sole handicap win; needs to leave latest efforts behind

runners.name: Reigning Profit
runners.spotlight: Exposed ten-time winner who was down the field in this 12 months ago when 1lb higher; won at Ripon this month (no headgear) before finishing fifth of seven 11 days ago at Pontefract (visored); a long time since he wore blinkers.
runners.comment: Exposed ten-time winner who was down the field in this 12 months ago when 1lb higher

runners.name: Run Boy Run
runners.spotlight: Made all in last season's Ayr Gold Cup (6f, soft) and competes off the same mark here after taking Toby Moore's claim into account; won over 5f at Meydan during the winter and gave it a good shot last time at Ascot (5f); finished fourth in last year's Stewards' Cup so handles this track; respected.
runners.comment: 4th in last year's Stewards' Cup; good latest effort; can feature with Tony Moore claiming

runners.name: Jasour
runners.spotlight: Group 1-class sprinter at his best but it's been a struggle this season since an encouraging start at Listed level and he now has his sights lowered for a first crack at a handicap; has a lot of weight and perhaps better at 6f than 5f.
runners.comment: Class-dropper with a lot of weight to carry and perhaps better at 6f than 5f

runners.name: Vintage Clarets
runners.spotlight: Two no-shows at Goodwood were at this meeting in 2023, including this race; however, provided the track doesn't pose any problems, he could be interesting after strong finishes in the Dash at Epsom and last time at Chester where a slow start was the last thing he needed; he should be coming home to some effect.
runners.comment: Strong finishes in his last two races and he should be coming home to some effect

runners.name: Democracy Dilemma
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; 3lb lower than for his runaway win at Haydock last September (5f, good) but hasn't got a lot going in his last four races and was tailed off in Epsom's Dash, in which he was second in 2024; others preferred.
runners.comment: Sits on a reduced mark but hasn't got a lot going in his last four races

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts & Geldings) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Final Objective
runners.spotlight: Similar type to Dorigo, having belied his 125-1 odds with a seemingly good effort over 6f at Royal Ascot (seventh of 21 in the Coventry) last time; hung right that day and gelded since.
runners.comment: Seemed to run well in the Coventry; hung right that day and gelded since

runners.name: Savage Mariner
runners.spotlight: Holds two major Group entries; solid second, behind the subsequent Albany winner, at Leicester; combination of drop to 5f and meeting trouble seemingly contributed to a poor effort at Royal Ascot; remains of interest.
runners.comment: Solid second at Leicester; perhaps best to forgive his Royal Ascot run; still of interest

runners.name: Dorigo
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced colt who holds a respectable chance assuming latest effort, namely 125-1 seventh of 25 from unfavourable draw in the Windsor Castle (6f) at Royal Ascot, is backed up.
runners.comment: Holds a respectable chance assuming his Windsor Castle effort is backed up

runners.name: Agrippa
runners.spotlight: Ties in with Launch Sequence on debut effort; neck second to unbeaten rival, pair clear, when favourite at Newbury (6f, good to firm) since; may take another step forward; major contender.
runners.comment: Ties in with Launch Sequence on debut effort; clear second at Newbury since; major player

runners.name: Shemiyla Star
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced colt whose opening mark of 71 reflects that his form claims are ordinary kept to maiden level today, rather than switching to a nursery; looked ill at ease on the Epsom track last time.
runners.comment: Holds ordinary form claims kept to this maiden level, rather than switching to a nursery

runners.name: Launch Sequence
runners.spotlight: Group 2 Gimcrack entry; very promising and eye-catching third of 11 in novice event (6f, good to firm) at Doncaster, finishing nicely under hands and heels once switched and in the clear (met traffic issues); respected.
runners.comment: Very promising and eye-catching third at Doncaster, finishing well under hands and heels

runners.name: Severn Councils
runners.spotlight: Finished 6l seventh in Listed event at Newbury (6f, good to firm; 66-1) where he was the sole newcomer in a field of ten; interesting dropped in class, with improvement plausible.
runners.comment: 66-1 when 6l seventh of ten in Newbury Listed race; interesting with improvement plausible

runners.name: Washington Royale
runners.spotlight: Has some ability but his two efforts suggest nurseries will be more suitable shortly; certainly needs improvement in this deep maiden.
runners.comment: Has some ability but should be more interesting in nurseries shortly

runners.name: Demonstrate
runners.spotlight: 60,000gns yearling; by Showcasing; sibling to three winners, notably Sense Of Duty (6f including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 116); dam 1m scorer (92); one of four newcomers in the field; market instructive.
runners.comment: 60,000gns yearling; by Showcasing; one of four newcomers in the field; market helpful

runners.name: Does Mary Know
runners.spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; by Dark Angel and first foal of 6f AW 2yo winner (RPR 73) whose siblings include 7f/1m 2yo scorer Starlight Time; starts off in a competitive maiden; check the betting.
runners.comment: 55,000gns yearling; by Dark Angel; starts off in a competitive maiden; check the betting

runners.name: Major Looktwice
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling, 45,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; Mehmas half-brother to three winners, notably Gavota (Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo; RPR 105); dam unraced; yard landed this race with a newcomer in 2017; interesting.
runners.comment: 45,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; yard landed this race with a newcomer in 2017; interesting

runners.name: Ground Force
runners.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; Land Force half-brother to 6f 2yo scorer Gesayed (RPR 77); dam maiden (62), half-sister to a few Listed-placed winners; faces a stiff-looking introduction.
runners.comment: 20,000gns yearling; by Land Force; faces a stiff-looking introduction

runners.name: Ard As A Rock
runners.spotlight: Showed ability by leading for long way in big-field event at Newbury (6f, good to firm; finished fifth) but the bare form gives him plenty to find in this festival maiden.
runners.comment: Led for long way in big-field event at Newbury but has plenty to find on that form

runners.name: Wolf Bay
runners.spotlight: Needs to improve markedly on the form he showed in a big field at Newbury (6f).
runners.comment: Needs to improve markedly on his Newbury effort

runners.name: Mr Resdev
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise with fourth of 11 at Thirsk (6f) and may be able to win a race, perhaps in the north; however, has a lot to find in this warm maiden, sent down south.
runners.comment: Showed some promise at Thirsk but has a lot to find in this warm maiden, sent down south

runners.name: Beach Noir
runners.spotlight: Made no impact in 7f contest at Sandown where he was one of the outsiders; handicaps are likely to be his thing in due course.
runners.comment: Made no impact in 7f contest at Sandown; one for nurseries later on

races.race_name: Bolney English Wine Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Crazee Icon
runners.spotlight: Took nine attempts to get off the mark but now bids for a hat-trick after two wins at Chester (7.5f; soft/good); up another 5lb but still one for the shortlist now that something has clearly clicked.
runners.comment: Bids for a hat-trick after two wins at Chester; up another 5lb but something has clicked

runners.name: Annastarzy
runners.spotlight: Has completely taken off lately, completing the hat-track when winning at Newbury (7f, good to firm); up another 6lb, but that latest form has been boosted by the subsequent wins of the second and fourth (twice); well drawn and very likely to make her presence felt; yard won this in 2021.
runners.comment: Bids for a four-timer off 6lb higher mark; latest form boosted; should make presence felt

runners.name: Atlantis Blue
runners.spotlight: 3-29, the latest win coming at Lingfield (1m1f, good) a year ago; still 3lb higher and although she may appreciate the return to turf, she looks vulnerable to less exposed rivals; stable also runs Perdy In Paris.
runners.comment: 3-29; may appreciate the return to turf but looks vulnerable to less exposed rivals

runners.name: Just Call Me Angel
runners.spotlight: Has a good strike-rate (4-9) including two Group wins at San Siro (1m, good); twice held since returning to home soil, latest when midfield in the Sandringham at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month; 2lb drop is not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Well held in last two starts, latest in the Sandringham; 2lb drop is not enough to tempt

runners.name: Rumba Numba
runners.spotlight: Defied a lengthy absence when winning at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) last month and then ran a fine race to finish fifth of 24 in the Kensington Palace at Ascot (1m, good to firm), especially as she met traffic; could have been better drawn, but she races off the same mark as last time and represents last year's winning stable; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Fifth in the Kensington Palace; drawn wide but represents last year's winning stable

runners.name: Song N Dance
runners.spotlight: Landed a Leicester novice (7f, good) and a Newcastle handicap (1m, AW) last autumn; solid efforts in her first two starts this term, but was a bit disappointing at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 17 days ago; drawn high and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: In good form since last autumn, until disappointing last time; needs to get back on track

runners.name: Proposal
runners.spotlight: Made a winning reappearance in Doncaster maiden (7f, good to firm) in April, but only fourth of eight when favourite for handicap debut at Windsor (1m, good to firm; started slowly) the following month; has a bit to find from the same mark and is drawn wide; stable won this in 2018 and 2020.
runners.comment: Unplaced when sent off favourite on handicap debut last time; bit to find from same mark

runners.name: Si Grass
runners.spotlight: Chased home this season's smart Inis Mor at Newmarket (7f, good to soft) in sole start as a 2yo and did well at Southwell (1m, AW) early this year, winning a maiden and going down narrowly under a penalty in a novice; makes her handicap debut after 167 days off; stable won this in 2024; watch market.
runners.comment: Has done well in three starts; makes handicap debut after 167 days off; watch market

runners.name: Wid
runners.spotlight: Has progressed in each of her three starts, making all in a Carlisle novice (1m, good to firm) latest; it's not clear how strong the form is, but she is bred to useful and respected on handicap debut despite her high draw.
runners.comment: Off the mark at Carlisle last time; respected on handicap debut despite her high draw

runners.name: Nanino Niyati
runners.spotlight: Both wins over 1m2f on good to firm ground, the latest a narrow success (on her second start for this yard) at Newbury last month; beaten less than a length into fourth of nine at Ascot (1m, good to firm) 17 days ago; back up 1lb and this sharper track is not sure to be in her favour.
runners.comment: Both wins over 1m2f; not beaten far over 1m last time, but the sharper track is a question

runners.name: Perdy In Paris
runners.spotlight: Placed on AW in all three starts, the latest when second of 14 in a Kempton maiden (7f) in May after six-month absence; returns from another break and looks a stiff task on handicap/turf debut from 3lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Placed on the AW in all three starts; this looks a stiff task on handicap/turf debut

runners.name: Electrifarhh
runners.spotlight: Seen only three times since winning a Kempton novice (1m, AW) in October 2024; hasn't shown enough in two starts this season to suggest she will be winning a race as competitive as this, albeit with a hood now given a go.
runners.comment: Seen only three times since winning a Kempton novice in October 2024; hood goes on

runners.name: Vixey
runners.spotlight: Won four times last year and was beaten less than a length into second of nine at Chester (7.5f, good; goes well there) 17 days ago; admirable sort, but looks weighted to her best and may prove vulnerable to younger rivals.
runners.comment: Won four times last year; second at Chester last time but vulnerable to younger rivals

runners.name: Star Mirage
runners.spotlight: Placed in all three starts over 7f late last year, firstly at Kempton (AW) and then twice at Meydan (dirt); clearly has ability, but has questions to answer on turf/handicap debut after 221 days off; market may help.
runners.comment: Placed in all three starts late last year; has questions to answer on turf/handicap debut

races.race_name: World Pool Bet With The tote EBF Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Secret History
runners.spotlight: It was over 7f that she won at the Newmarket July meeting but she raced freely off steady fractions there and won her novice at this trip; 1lb lower than last time if taking into account Ashley Lewis's claim and this improving filly could yet rate higher.
runners.comment: Improving 3yo who shouldn't be troubled by this drop back to 6f; looks on a good mark

runners.name: Rogue Attraction
runners.spotlight: Highly tried last season after winning her maiden; back on track in just her second handicap when prevailing by a length in second-time cheekpieces at Carlisle (6f, good to firm); it could be onwards and upwards from there and she took only a 3lb hit.
runners.comment: It could be onwards and upwards from her Carlisle win and she took only a 3lb hit.

runners.name: Machadadorp
runners.spotlight: Made debut over 1m; confined to 7f since, winning minor races at Chester and Wetherby before bumping into what looked a handicap snip at Newmarket's July meeting (good to firm; this filly was sent off favourite); looks quick enough for 6f and has to be feared for a flying-high stable.
runners.comment: Bumped into a handicap snip on handicap debut over 7f; looks quick enough for 6f

runners.name: Ruby's Angel
runners.spotlight: York handicap winner last season and overcame a wide draw at Chester in May (6f, good; 4lb lower); good and bad since, though saw too much daylight when returned to 7f at Newmarket last time (behind Machadadorp); better can be expected, assuming she copes with this new experience.
runners.comment: Dual 6f winner; saw too much daylight when returned to 7f at Newmarket last time

runners.name: Zen Diva
runners.spotlight: Promise in defeat last season; won a Ripon novice by 7l in May (6f, good; first-time cheekpieces) and followed up in a three-runner handicap at Salisbury (6f, good to firm; one of her rivals lost all chance at the start); it's hard to rate that form highly and she's 6lb higher, but this well-related filly could have a whole lot more to offer for shrewd connections.
runners.comment: Dubious form in winning at Salisbury but this filly could have a whole lot more to offer

runners.name: Bintaryana
runners.spotlight: Ran just once at two and firmly on the upgrade this season, leading late on to win at York in mid-June (6f, good; unraced on firmer) in her second handicap; that narrow verdict was a blessing as she's only 2lb higher; would appreciate some give in the ground, according to her trainer, but dangerously unexposed if conditions are suitable.
runners.comment: York winner when delivered late; dangerously unexposed off only 2lb higher

runners.name: Cindy Lou Who
runners.spotlight: Won three sprints last year on extremes of going; however, a near-miss at Listed level in April put paid to her handicap mark and others look better treated.
runners.comment: A near-miss at Listed level in April put paid to her handicap mark

runners.name: Diamont Katie
runners.spotlight: First run after wind surgery when winning easily at Pontefract in April but no further improvement has been forthcoming; returning to 6f is probably no bad thing but others are more intriguing.
runners.comment: Returning to 6f is probably no bad thing but others are more intriguing
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Lxxiv & M Hulin

runners.name: Sing The Blues
runners.spotlight: Won her novice over C&D (good) for William Haggas whom she left for 6,000gns; that looks a bargain after she emerged from last to first when denying Shallow over 6f at Newmarket 11 days ago; that was quite taking and she could still be nicely treated off 5lb higher.
runners.comment: Yard debut win at Newmarket was quite taking; could still be nicely treated off 5lb higher

runners.name: Polka Blue
runners.spotlight: Has won handicaps this year at 6f (good to firm) and 7f (AW); similar chance to Shallow on last month's Newmarket clash and the leaders never came back when third from off the pace at Chester latest (6f, good); each-way shout.
runners.comment: Similar chance to Shallow on last month's Newmarket clash; latest defeat forgiven

runners.name: Paradise Walk
runners.spotlight: All the better for blinkers going on in recent starts but she ran only last Friday when beaten fair and square off this mark at Ascot (5f); there are no guarantees that returning to 6f will see her to better effect.
runners.comment: She ran only last Friday when beaten fair and square off this mark at Ascot (5f)

runners.name: Fleetwater
runners.spotlight: Close up over C&D in June (soft) and gained her first win away from Windsor when challenging 1f out and just holding on at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) on latest start; 2lb rise is no big deal but this race is way deeper.
runners.comment: A 2lb rise for the Salisbury success is no big deal but this race is way deeper
runners.owner: Ms H N Pinniger And Partner

runners.name: Gold Digger
runners.spotlight: Maiden/novice wins at 6f; ran okay to be ninth of 27 on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm; second favourite) before flying too high in a Group 3 at Sandown, again wandering under pressure; not yet exposed and she's returning to what is probably her best trip; wears first-time tongue-tie and cheekpieces; interesting.
runners.comment: Not yet exposed and she's returning to what is probably her best trip; headgear fitted

runners.name: Shallow
runners.spotlight: Races prominently; behind some of these in a 7f handicap at the Newmarket July meeting but the visor went on back there 11 days ago and, in a 6f handicap she'd won the previous year, she beat all bar late player Sing The Blues; her close third behind Bintaryana at York in June is another key piece of form that heightens interest.
runners.comment: Exposed mare but has claims on her best form and the visor worked well last time

runners.name: Beaujolais Nouveau
runners.spotlight: First-time cheekpieces and a reduced mark when coming good again at Ripon (6f, good) in May and she was close up in Bintaryana's race at York next time; the latter form in particular raises hopes but she was off her game last time at Pontefract.
runners.comment: The fifth at York in June raises hopes but she was off her game last time at Pontefract

runners.name: Angel Shared
runners.spotlight: Often leads; ran in a Listed race in May but underwhelming handicap efforts since on Newmarket's July course and she usually runs that track well; needs a revival and she's unraced here.
runners.comment: Often leads; six-time winner but she needs a revival and is unraced here

runners.name: Hold A Dream
runners.spotlight: Highly tried after winning her novice in 2024, confined to Listed and Group races ever since; it's difficult to gauge where she is right now and cheekpieces are turned to.
runners.comment: Downgraded; it's difficult to gauge where she is right now and cheekpieces are turned to

runners.name: Woohoo
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner having a consistent season but her handicap mark hasn't really gone anywhere despite several placed efforts over 5f in lower-grade races than this; has won over this far but the chances are she'll come up short once again.
runners.comment: Her handicap mark hasn't really gone anywhere despite several placed efforts

runners.name: Stormy Impact
runners.spotlight: Won the 3yo Dash at Epsom (5f, good) last term and fourth in the older-horse version this season; just as effective at 6f and she never got a chance to show her true colours last time at Chester; lacking course experience is not ideal but she's not dismissed.
runners.comment: Has the form to feature and Chester last time never went to plan; unraced at Goodwood

runners.name: Cinque Verde
runners.spotlight: Career win number ten when scooting clear in a Class 3 fillies' handicap at Newmarket in early May and she ran in a Listed race next time; however, she went up 12lb for that last win and looks vulnerable off this mark.
runners.comment: Went up 12lb for winning her last handicap and looks vulnerable off this mark

races.race_name: Lady Jane Bethell Memorial Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Star Start
runners.spotlight: Dead-heated in this race last season (1lb lower), and having run his best race since a wind op when a close third over C&D last time (Sunny Orange second) is one to consider.
runners.comment: Joint winner of this in 2025; fine C&D third on 2nd run after wind op last time; chance

runners.name: Alazwar
runners.spotlight: Won over this trip for today's rider at Newbury last June (good to firm); rather inconsistent since, but fine second to an in-form rival at Chepstow last time (1m2f, good to soft; The Pug just behind in third); a possible off current good mark.
runners.comment: Not won since June 2025, but on a good mark and sound run at Chepstow last time; contender

runners.name: Sandret
runners.spotlight: Won at Redcar and Thirsk for today's rider last season (both over 1m on good ground), but hasn't shown the same level of form in two runs this term; conditions suit and back on last winning mark.
runners.comment: Two wins for this rider in 2025; below par this term; conditions suit and on a good mark

runners.name: Stipulation
runners.spotlight: Won twice last season, first time over this trip on good to firm at Yarmouth; hasn't done as well this term; now back on last winning mark.
runners.comment: Two wins in 2025, first at 1m2f on good to firm; below par recently; on last winning mark
runners.owner: Horn And Trumpet Lads & S & A Mares

runners.name: Little She
runners.spotlight: 18-race maiden; some fair form this season, including when second at Chepstow two runs back; handles these conditions and has an each-way chance.
runners.comment: 0-18; decent second at Chepstow two runs back (1m2f) and has an each-way chance

runners.name: Perfidia
runners.spotlight: Two wins this term, latest at Nottingham last month (8.5f, good to firm); two close seconds since; an obvious contender but stamina to prove on first run at 1m2f (stays 1m1f).
runners.comment: Two wins this term and still in good form; contender on first run at 1m2f (stays 1m1f)

runners.name: The Pug
runners.spotlight: Ex-Micky Hammond; close third at Chepstow on stable debut in June (1m2f, good to soft; Alwazar was 0.5l in front in second); well beaten over 1m6f on AW last time; should fare better back down in trip.
runners.comment: Ex-Micky Hammond; good third on stable debut; didn't stay 1m6f latest; interesting

runners.name: Sunny Orange
runners.spotlight: Last four wins have been over 7.5f/87.5f here, three on fast ground; beaten 0.5l by a stable companion over C&D on first try at 1m2f last time (Star Start 0.5l back in third); contender.
runners.comment: Goes well here and only just beaten on first run at 1m2f here last time; contender

races.race_name: Thank You Kathy Burne Selling Handicap

runners.name: Talking In Kode
runners.spotlight: In good form without winning in handicaps, not enjoying a smooth passage when fifth of eight in 1m2f handicap at Redcar nine days ago; visor replaces cheekpieces; drops in grade now and holds leading claims.
runners.comment: In good form without winning in handicaps; drops in grade now and holds leading claims

runners.name: La Trinite
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 below par for Mike Murphy but she's returned in good nick for her new yard, placed in handicaps at Brighton (1m4f) and Lingfield (2m) this summer; very much one to consider dropped in grade.
runners.comment: In good nick for new yard, placed at Brighton and Lingfield; very much one to consider

runners.name: Blackwater Lilly
runners.spotlight: Scored over hurdles but a modest Flat maiden for Brian Ellison; comes here in good nick over hurdles for new yard, sixth at Uttoxeter 13 days ago; not out of things back in this sphere.
runners.comment: In good nick over hurdles for new yard; not out of things back in this sphere

runners.name: Head Girl
runners.spotlight: Took a big step forward in first-time cheekpieces with third at Lingfield (11.5f) in May but she beat only one in 1m4f Epsom handicap 27 days ago; well in the mix if back on song here.
runners.comment: Very good Lingfield third but beat one at Epsom since; well in the mix if back on song

runners.name: Porter's Song
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden for Edward Bethell but beat only two for new yard when ninth in 1m2f handicap at Pontefract last month; more is needed.
runners.comment: Beat two for new yard when ninth in handicap at Pontefract last month; more is needed

runners.name: Character Testing
runners.spotlight: Winless since January 2024; raced mainly over hurdles subsequently and posted a solid fourth over hurdles at Uttoxeter 13 days ago; visor goes on for the first time.
runners.comment: Raced mainly over hurdles; solid Uttoxeter fourth latest; not discounted back on Flat

runners.name: Ruler Of The River
runners.spotlight: Modest winning hurdler for Fergal O'Brien last autumn; came in last of six for new stable in 1m4f Catterick handicap 13 days ago; not easy to make a case for.
runners.comment: Last of six for new stable in Catterick handicap 13 days ago; not easy to make a case for

races.race_name: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (For Horses In Band D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Eleven Eighty Two
runners.spotlight: Ardad filly who has progressed with each of her three runs, runner-up in 11-runner maiden at Ripon (6f) 27 days ago; holds good form claims; engaged 7:40 Ripon Monday.
runners.comment: Very good runner-up at Ripon 27 days ago; the clear form pick; engaged 7:40 Ripon Monday

runners.name: Maximus Meridius
runners.spotlight: Son of Persian Force who has shown fair form when placed in 6f Ayr maiden and 6f Pontefract novice this summer, no extra last half furlong on latter occasion having gone keenly in front; a player here dropping back in trip.
runners.comment: Fair form when placed at Ayr and Pontefract novice this summer; player back in trip now
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Lexington Boom
runners.spotlight: 9-2, made an encouraging start with second of six in maiden at Musselburgh (5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; this Ardad colt is open to progress and must enter calculations.
runners.comment: Encouraging start with Musselburgh second; open to progress and must enter calculations

runners.name: Black Velvet Boy
runners.spotlight: Son of Soldier's Call who was much improved from his debut with third of 11 in maiden over C&D eight days ago; he may do better still though has a high draw here.
runners.comment: Good third in maiden over C&D eight days ago; may do better still though has a high draw

runners.name: Dorothea Hope
runners.spotlight: Sent off 66-1 but shaped with promise when a debut fourth of 11 in maiden over C&D (good to firm) eight days ago; this daughter of Invincible Army needs considering with likely better to come.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise when a debut fourth over C&D; considered with likely better to come

runners.name: Malulee
runners.spotlight: Lope Y Fernandez filly; dam, unplaced over 6f/7f (RPR 52), is a half-sister to 5f winner Country Carnival, out of Listed-placed 5f-6f winning half-sister to useful 6f-1m winner Yourartisonfire; in good hands and a considered newcomer, especially if the market vibes are positive.
runners.comment: Lope Y Fernandez filly; in good hands and needs considering; needs a market check

runners.name: Purrista
runners.spotlight: 18,000 guineas foal, 12,000gns yearling; dam, placed over 9.4f/1m3f AW (RPR 64), is a sister to French Group-placed 7f/1m 2yo winner Rose Bloom; the betting can prove an accurate indicator for this Caturra filly.
runners.comment: The betting can prove an accurate indicator for this Caturra filly

runners.name: Classy Jaguar
runners.spotlight: Pearl Secret gelding; half-brother to five winners, notably Ey Up Its The Boss (7f-1m2f; RPR 93) and Ey Up It's Maggie (5f; RPR 91); dam unraced; the market can guide for this newcomer.
runners.comment: Pearl Secret gelding; the market can guide for this newcomer

runners.name: Ava Louise
runners.spotlight: 33-1, last of five in maiden at Brighton (5.5f, good to firm) on her debut last month; this Territories filly needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Last of five in maiden at Brighton on her debut; needs to take a big step forward

runners.name: Angel Steps
runners.spotlight: Alkumait filly; well held in 5.5f Wetherby novice and 5f Catterick maiden last month; significantly more is required.
runners.comment: Well held in Wetherby novice and Catterick maiden; significantly more is required

runners.name: Desert Outlaw
runners.spotlight: 80-1, ninth of 11 in novice at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) on his debut 27 days ago; lots more is needed from this son of Arizona.
runners.comment: Ninth of 11 in novice at Thirsk on debut; lots more is needed from this son of Arizona

runners.name: Noccalula Falls
runners.spotlight: 50-1, well-held sixth of ten in novice at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) on her debut 27 days ago; plenty more is required from this Soldier's Cally filly.
runners.comment: Well-held sixth at Thirsk on her debut 27 days ago; plenty more is required

runners.name: Mr De Maggs
runners.spotlight: Has failed to beat a rival in 6f Carlisle maiden and 5f Catterick novice this summer; it's easy to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Has failed to beat a rival in 6f Carlisle maiden and 5f Catterick novice this summer

runners.name: Dave's Matey
runners.spotlight: Yet to show any ability in his three runs to date; gelded before beating one in 7f Redcar maiden nine days ago.
runners.comment: Yet to show any ability in his three runs to date, beating one at Redcar nine days ago

races.race_name: 30 Years Of The Hurn Racing Club EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Romanza
runners.spotlight: Best run when 4.5l seventh of 14 in the Chesham in June (7f, good to firm); fair second at Lingfield (AW) next time but not sure to confirm that form with third-placed Apulia Bay, who was making his debut.
runners.comment: Best run when 7th in the Chesham; not sure to confirm Lingfield AW form with Apulia Bay

runners.name: Giant Dan Burn
runners.spotlight: Stradavarius half-brother to four winners at up to 1m1f, one Group-placed in Germany; bought for 140,000euros as a yearling; interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: 140,000euros yearling by Stradavarius; half-brother to 4 winners; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Apulia Bay
runners.spotlight: 600,000gns yearling by Too Darn Hot; 2l third of nine at Lingfield (AW) on debut this month (7f; more experienced Romanza was second); closely related to a very useful turf performer; major contender.
runners.comment: 600,000gns yearling; creditable third in AW novice on debut; leading contender

runners.name: Vega King
runners.spotlight: By Lucky Vega; 68,000euros yearling; beaten only 1.5l when fourth of five in an Ayr novice on debut 15 days ago (7f, good to firm; 5-2); should improve.
runners.comment: Beaten 1.5l when fourth at 5-2 in Ayr novice on debut and should improve for the run

races.race_name: Hoof Hustle Handicap

runners.name: Norcross Brow
runners.spotlight: In good form since 8,000gns buy in April, winning off 5lb lower at Brighton in June (7f, good to firm; 8-11) before a good second to a subsequent winner at Doncaster nine days later (1m, good to firm); contender.
runners.comment: 8,000gns buy who won at Brighton in June (7f) and was 2nd over 1m last time; contender

runners.name: Walk On Walk On
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race of the season when close second in a low-grade C&D handicap last time (good to firm); has a stiffer task up in grade here.
runners.comment: Close second over C&D last time but faces stiffer task up in grade here

runners.name: Napolian
runners.spotlight: Beat a 1-9 shot in a match at Leicester last month (1m, good to firm), but well-beaten last of 11 in a stronger race at York next time (1m, good to firm); bit to prove.
runners.comment: Beat a 1-9 shot in a match last month, but well beaten only run since; bit to prove

runners.name: Dumfries
runners.spotlight: Two of his three wins last year were on fast ground over C&D; well beaten over C&D on belated reappearance two weeks ago; shpuld come on for that.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins in 2025 (good to firm); well beaten on belated reappearance; better expected
runners.owner: Buist, Shields, Thompson And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Carolus Magnus
runners.spotlight: Off the mark for the season when winning by a neck at Musselburgh last time (7f, good); could go well again but bit disappointing in only previous run here.
runners.comment: Neck winner at Musselburgh last time (made all); could go well but below par only run here

runners.name: Willowinghurn
runners.spotlight: Won twice last season (6f, good to firm; 7f, soft), although was disappointing on last two runs; hasn't recaptured her form this season; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Two wins (6f/7f) last season; hasn't recaptured her form this time; best watched for now

runners.name: Lady Hornblower
runners.spotlight: C&D novice winner last August (good to firm); hasn't recaptured her form in three handicaps this season (favourite on first occasion) but returns on a 6lb lower mark having had a wind operation.
runners.comment: C&D novice win last August; below that form this year, but returns having had a wind op

races.race_name: It's Ladies Day Next On 12 August Handicap

runners.name: Azuinthejungle
runners.spotlight: Won three on the trot last season (5f/6f); off the mark for the current year when scoring at Ayr 15 days ago (6f, good to firm); up 3lb; should go well again.
runners.comment: Won three on the trot in 2025; off the mark for 2026 at Ayr latest; should go well again
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

runners.name: Golden Havana
runners.spotlight: Yet to win on turf, but sound runs when runner-up at Thirsk (5f, good) and Ayr (5f, good to firm) on last two starts; one with a chance.
runners.comment: 0-4 on turf; runner-up at Thirsk and Ayr on last two starts; one with a chance

runners.name: Crafty Spirit
runners.spotlight: Three sound runs this term, winning his last two, at Wetherby in June (5.5f, good to firm) and over C&D two weeks ago (good to firm); this looks a stronger race, but he could go well again.
runners.comment: Three sound runs this term, winning at Wetherby and over C&D last twice; could go well

runners.name: Without Flaw
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner last July (good to firm/soft); yet to hit top form this season, although hasn't been beaten far on last two runs.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner last July; not hit top form this season, although fair runs last twice

runners.name: Empress Olivia
runners.spotlight: Has been rather disappointing since winning off 1lb lower at Ripon in April (6f, good to soft), including in cheekpieces two runs ago (last of 13 at York); effective at 5f; easier ground suits.
runners.comment: Mainly disappointing since Ripon win in April (6f); 5f no problem but easier ground suits

runners.name: Opal Storm
runners.spotlight: Two wins this term, the first at Southwell in April and the second over C&D last week (good to firm); could go well from her low draw, but lacks consistency.
runners.comment: Two wins this term, the first on AW in April, the second over C&D last week; inconsistent

runners.name: Speeding Bullet
runners.spotlight: Mainly in good form last season, winning over 6f at Pontefract in June (6f, good); disappointing this season, but now 3lb below his last winning mark.
runners.comment: Pontefract winner last season; disappointing this term; well treated but bit to prove
runners.owner: Slaters Arms Racing And Ged Shields

runners.name: Jojo Rabbit
runners.spotlight: Pontefract winner in April (5f, good to soft); two good runs in May, the first when second over this C&D; hasn't been in such good form on last two runs.
runners.comment: Pontefract win in April; two good runs, including over C&D, in May; below par last twice
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing XIII & Ruth Carr

runners.name: Le Beau Garcon
runners.spotlight: Won 5f Ayr handicap off 6lb higher in May last year (5f, good to firm) but mainly disappointing since, including on last two starts; bit to prove at present.
runners.comment: 5f Ayr winner in May 2025; mainly disappointing since; well treated but bit to prove

races.race_name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap

runners.name: Educator
runners.spotlight: Losing run up to 15, but has run well to be placed in his last two starts since the blinkers went back on, at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) last month and at Lingfield (1m5f, AW) 15 days ago; player.
runners.comment: Losing run up to 15, but has run well to be placed in his last two starts; player

runners.name: Expressionless
runners.spotlight: Not at his best lately, but is back off the same mark as when winning at Leicester (1m4f, good) in April; has won three times over this trip including here and has a solid chance if producing anything like his best.
runners.comment: Has won three times over the trip including here; back off last winning mark; solid chance

runners.name: Baltic
runners.spotlight: Won five in a row at around 1m4f on turf/AW for the Charltons between September 2023 and July 2024, but has suffered heavy defeats in all three starts since returning for this yard in May; new headgear combination will need to make a big difference.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in all three starts since returning for this yard in May; new headgear

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Mithaaly
runners.spotlight: 260,000gns yearling; sent off a weak 17-2 shot for his Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago, but ran well to be beaten under a length into second of the 12 runners; shouldn't have a problem with the extra furlong and very much respected.
runners.comment: Close second on Windsor debut; no problem with the extra furlong; very much respected

runners.name: Majestic Jude
runners.spotlight: March foal by Minzaal; 75,000gns yearling, 160,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to winners Atomic Force (5f/6f including 2yo Group 2; RPR 112), Inexorable Tide (1m/8.6f AW; 85), Dansing Bear (1m4f AW; 68) and Wilsons Ruby (6f-1m including 2yo/AW); dam 10.5f winner (90); nice pedigree and market should be revealing on debut.
runners.comment: Nice pedigree and market should be revealing on debut

runners.name: Noble Prince
runners.spotlight: March foal by Frankel; first foal; dam 7f/1m winner (including 2yo/AW/dirt/Listed; RPR 110), closely related to useful 1m2f/11.5f winner Soft Winds, out of 1m2f/11.4f winning half-sister to Group 2 winners Policy Maker (1m4f) and Pushkin (1m6f); plenty to like on breeding and the stable's record both here and with 2yos first time out make him worthy of respect.
runners.comment: Stable's record both here and with 2yos first time out make him worthy of respect

runners.name: Moheebb
runners.spotlight: April foal by Showcasing; 35,000gns foal, 60,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Air To Air (7f/1m; RPR 103) and Walson's Law (7f/1m; 91); dam unplaced 6f-8.5f (46), half-sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Air Pilot, out of 1m6f winner; something to like on breeding and stable does have the occasional winning 2yo newcomer; market useful.
runners.comment: Something to like on breeding; stable has the occasion winning 2yo newcomer; market useful

runners.name: Note To Self
runners.spotlight: Gradually getting there and was having his third start when beaten a head at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago; may improve again, but Mithaaly recorded a much quicker time when runner-up in the other division; further progress needed.
runners.comment: Just beaten at Windsor last time, but Mithaaly ran a quicker time in the other division

runners.name: Rocket Boy
runners.spotlight: March foal by Soldier's Call; 33,000gns foal, 65,000gns yearling; half-brother to six winners including Tawdeea (1m-1m4f including AW; RPR 109), Alward (1m1f-1m2f including Australia; 98) and Shadal (1m-9.5f including 2yo/AW/Australia; 83); dam 1m2f winner (93), half-sister to 1m4f Group 2 winner Maraahel; enough to like on breeding and the market should reveal what is expected.
runners.comment: Enough to like on breeding and the market should reveal what is expected

races.race_name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap

runners.name: Luminous Warrior
runners.spotlight: Had fallen 6lb below his sole winning mark when beaten a length into second of seven over C&D (good to firm) this month; drops into a 0-55 for the first time and he's high on list.
runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D this month; drops into a 0-55 for the first time and he's high on list

runners.name: Turpin
runners.spotlight: Latest fifth of nine in a 0-50 classified event at Lingfield (1m, AW; first-time visor) was probably better than it looks, but he has finished unplaced in all 11 starts so something extra will be needed.
runners.comment: Has finished unplaced in all 11 starts so something extra will be needed

runners.name: Heer's Sadie
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner over 6f-1m including twice last summer; best effort since when runner-up to a thriving rival in a 0-50 classified over C&D (soft) last month; inconsistent, but still worth considering.
runners.comment: Three-time course winner over 6f-1m; inconsistent, but still worth considering

runners.name: Chloe's Courage
runners.spotlight: Made an encouraging return from six months off when third of six behind an in-form rival at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago; down another 1lb and although shorter trips may suit her better, she still makes more appeal than most.
runners.comment: Ran well on her recent Newmarket return; makes more appeal than most

runners.name: Eagle Landed
runners.spotlight: 0-20 and best form (such as it is) has come on soft ground; moderate in four starts last year and makes little appeal back from nine months off.
runners.comment: 0-20; makes little appeal back from nine months off

races.race_name: Play At The Races Stableduel Handicap

runners.name: Nuptown Girl
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 15th attempt in a steadily run race at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) last month, but didn't match that form off the same mark at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm) one week later; needs to bounce back in first-time cheekpieces for last year's winning stable.
runners.comment: Won at Newmarket last month, but disappointed at Chepstow last time; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Pride Eye
runners.spotlight: Made an encouraging turf debut after 124 days off when fourth of eight at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) this month; back off the same mark as when winning at Southwell (1m, AW; 66-1) in January and she's one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Made an encouraging turf debut when fourth at Nottingham this month; back on winning mark

runners.name: Dinah Myte
runners.spotlight: Both wins over 1m, at Ffos Las (heavy) last September and at Newcastle (AW) last month; finished second of six at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) this month and she is one for the shortlist off the same mark.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Nottingham this month and one for the shortlist off the same mark

runners.name: Divot
runners.spotlight: Well backed when making all and winning easily at the 17th attempt over C&D (good to firm) this month; up 7lb, but a chance he may enjoy his own way again so could be hard to catch if he does.
runners.comment: Easily made all over C&D last time; could be hard to catch despite 7lb rise

runners.name: Pure Theory
runners.spotlight: 0-19 and finished around 12l behind Divot over C&D (good to firm) last time; hard to warm to.
runners.comment: 0-19 and finished around 12l behind Divot over C&D last time; hard to warm to

runners.name: Withoutfurtherado
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden when trained in Ireland and was always behind on his stable debut/reappearance at Kempton (7f, AW) in May; off another three months since and has enough to prove, not least stamina.
runners.comment: 0-15 and failed to beat a rival on stable debut; enough to prove, not least stamina

races.race_name: Winning Experience With Moulton Racing Classified Stakes

runners.name: Nymphaea
runners.spotlight: Seemed to win with a bit more in hand than the margin would suggest when beating Charencey by a neck in a 0-50 apprentice classified event at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) one week ago; stamina not in doubt over this longer trip having won over 1m6f at the same track last month; high on the list.
runners.comment: Beat Charencey by a neck at Nottingham a week ago; stays at least this far; high on list

runners.name: Stintino Sunset
runners.spotlight: Running well lately, chasing home a subsequent winner at Epsom (1m4f, good) last time; losing run is up to 17, though, so she may again find one or two too good.
runners.comment: Losing run is up to 17 so she may again find one or two too good

runners.name: Charencey
runners.spotlight: Three wins have come over 6f/7f, but he was beaten only a neck by Nymphaea in a 0-50 apprentice classified event at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) a week ago; attempts this far for the first time, but still a player on that latest performance.
runners.comment: Beaten a neck by Nymphaea at Nottingham a week ago; a player on that performance

runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: Has run well on good to firm, but looks best on a softer surface; either way a record of 2-49 sounds a note of caution; stable won this last year.
runners.comment: Record of 2-49 sounds a note of caution; stable won this last year

runners.name: Fletcher
runners.spotlight: 0-8; not disgraced when third of seven in a similar contest over C&D (good to firm) 13 days ago, but will need to do better again if he is to make an impact.
runners.comment: 0-8; not disgraced over C&D 13 days ago, but will need to do better again

runners.name: Churchill's Spirit
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who showed a bit more when third of seven in a similar contest at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) three weeks ago; runner-up has won since, but she still has something to prove back up in trip.
runners.comment: 0-5; showed a bit more last time, but has something to prove back up in trip
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Lvi & Mrs G Jarvis

runners.name: Twilight Guest
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick in the middle of last year, but 0-11 since despite a plummeting mark; needs a resurgence.
runners.comment: Completed a hat-trick in the middle of last year, but 0-11 since despite a plummeting mark

races.race_name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap

runners.name: Noble Guest
runners.spotlight: Both wins came over C&D last year and has dropped 5lb lower than for the latest in September; modest effort at Southwell (7f, AW) last time, but still of interest returned to this track.
runners.comment: Both wins came over C&D and he has dropped 5lb lower than for the latest; interesting

runners.name: Orange Emperor
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has been a bit in and out since handicapping and the removal of the hood (still missing) made no difference when third of four at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) last time; needs a bit more.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who has been a bit in and out since handicapping; needs a bit more

runners.name: Thapa Vc
runners.spotlight: Had his ideal combination of fast ground and a strong pace when back to winning form at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) ten days ago; only 2lb higher and much respected if this pans out in a similar way, which looks a possibility.
runners.comment: Only 2lb higher than when winning at Doncaster ten days ago; suited by a strong pace

runners.name: Methgal
runners.spotlight: Ran three times as a 2yo for Karl Burke before moving to Ireland, where he won a handicap at Dundalk (7f, AW) in March; makes his debut for last year's winning stable having changed hands for 6,000gns this month; market useful.
runners.comment: Makes his stable debut having changed hands for 6,000gns this month; market useful

runners.name: Rusheen Boy
runners.spotlight: Went up 5lb for winning a match over C&D (soft) last month and was well held off this mark at Nottingham (1m, good to firm) last time; others look better treated.
runners.comment: Went up 5lb for winning a match over C&D last month; well held off this mark last time

runners.name: El Carrusel
runners.spotlight: 0-8; finished second of five on nursery debut here (1m, good to soft) last September, but well beaten in four outings since; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: 0-8; second of five on nursery debut here last September, but well beaten since
runners.owner: The Boys Are Back In Town

runners.name: Minshaar
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who has dropped 1lb lower than when winning a handicap at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) for Richard Fahey last November, but will need to show a lot more than when tailed off on stable debut at Southwell (1m, AW) in March.
runners.comment: 1lb below last winning mark, but well beaten on stable debut; off five months

runners.name: Mayfair Market
runners.spotlight: 0-7; hasn't built on the promise she showed on a couple of occasions last year and the application of a tongue-tie has made little difference; best watched.
runners.comment: 0-7; hasn't built on the promise she showed on a couple of occasions last year

runners.name: Way To Dubai
runners.spotlight: Better effort when fourth of ten at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) this month and now 2lb below his last winning mark, but he is just 1-42 in Britain.
runners.comment: 2lb below his last winning mark, but he is just 1-42 in Britain

races.race_name: COLM QUINN BMW Novice Hurdle (Listed Race)

runners.name: Lizzie Twigg
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; has made a flawless start over hurdles, winning a Punchestown maiden hurdle (16.5f, gd-yld) by 8.25l and a Roscommon novice (2m, good) by 3.5l; unexposed and preferred by Jack Kennedy; obvious chance.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, unbeaten in two starts over timber, preferred by Kennedy, obvious chance

runners.name: Porcupine Bank
runners.spotlight: One of two for yard; 2-3 over hurdles and rated 130; won Punchestown 4yo maiden in mid-May (2m, good); added a 4yo hurdle at Ballinrobe (2m, good) later that month; could be more to come but Jack Kennedy prefers the chances of Lizzie Twigg.
runners.comment: 2-3 over hurdles and rated 130, landed 4yo hurdle latest, overlooked by Kennedy

runners.name: Magico
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat and rated 89; made a winning start for this yard over hurdles at Killarney in May (2m1f, gd-yld); heavy defeat in a Punchestown novice on latest too bad to be true (small graze on right-fore cannon bone); no surprise were he to bounce back.
runners.comment: Rated 89 on Flat, won Killarney maiden hurdle in May, latest run too bad to be true

runners.name: Gomez Addams
runners.spotlight: Won a bumper in fine style at this meeting last year for Andy Slattery; disappointed in a Leopardstown bumper on debut for this yard in December; much more like it when winning on hurdling debut at Listowel (16.5f, good) latest and the third from that race has won since; big player.
runners.comment: Course bumper winner, off the mark over hurdles at Listowel, form boosted, chance

runners.name: Milan Forth
runners.spotlight: Decent strike rate over fences (3-10) and rated 121; disappointed on sole start over hurdles at Punchestown in April and beaten 5l in Kilbeggan handicap chase on latest; cheekpieces worn that day discarded; others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: 3-10 over fences and rated 121, moderate run sole previous start over timber

runners.name: Fastnet Crystal
runners.spotlight: Close second in a Punchestown bumper in January (2m, sft-hvy); justified favouritism to land an ordinary Downpatrick mares' maiden hurdle (2m2f, good) two weeks ago; this is harder but she's unexposed in this sphere so don't discount.
runners.comment: 0-2 in bumpers, easy win on hurdling debut latest, unexposed but this demands more
runners.owner: Nicholas Fahy/Mrs Orla Fahy/Two Sheets to the Wind Syndicate

runners.name: Brave Lady
runners.spotlight: Runner up in two of four starts in bumpers; filled the same spot on hurdling debut in a mares' maiden at Kilbeggan; this is much tougher.
runners.comment: Maiden has run well in defeat, runner up on hurdles debut latest, this much tougher

runners.name: Brosna Town
runners.spotlight: Flat winner; 0-4 over hurdles and rated 103; 1.25l second in Market Rasen maiden hurdle 23 days ago (20.5f, good); cheekpieces go on but surely out of depth in this company; due to run 5.40 here on Monday.
runners.comment: Flat winner, 0-4 and rated 103 over hurdles, out of depth in this company

runners.name: Bruise Hill
runners.spotlight: 0-2 in point-to-points and 0-4 over hurdles; beaten off 82 in Cork handicap hurdle on latest; this looks far too demanding.
runners.comment: Maiden pointer, 0-4 over hurdles and rated 82, impossible to fancy

races.race_name: Latin Quarter Beginners Chase

runners.name: Bowensonfire
runners.spotlight: Very useful over hurdles (5-18, rated 147); goes on any ground and should be sharper for his latest run in a Grade 3 hurdle at Limerick after an 87 day break; every chance he'll take to this game on breeding; big player on chase debut.
runners.comment: Talented hurdler (rated 147), ground versatile, sharper for latest, chance on chase bow

runners.name: My Great Mate
