runners.spotlight: Novice hurdle winner here in October 2024 (20.5f, soft); lightly raced since; sent off the 6-4 favourite in this last year on return from 234 days off and found just one too good; similar preparation this year and Townend keeps the faith; player.
runners.comment: 2-6 over hurdles, beaten fav' in this last year on return from break, Townend keeps faith

runners.name: Love Me Tender
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; bumper winner; 2-6 over hurdles and rated 135; has come up short in graded hurdles on last four starts; dam a useful chaser so could take to this discipline; tongue tie goes on; not discounted.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, rated 135 over hurdles, bred to make a chaser, tongue tie on

runners.name: Jolie Jewel
runners.spotlight: 2-18 over hurdles; rated 114 after two chase starts; rallied well for a close second in Punchestown novice chase on latest (20.5f, gd-yld); more needed dropped in trip.
runners.comment: Rallied well for second at Punchestown latest, rated 114, this looks too demanding

runners.name: Arch Empire
runners.spotlight: 1-13 and rated 117 over hurdles; below best in that sphere in 2026 and moderate run in Flat maiden at Killarney on latest; best watched on chase debut.
runners.comment: 1-13 over hurdles and rated 117, below best in 2026, best watched on chase debut

runners.name: Frankie John
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; scored in a bumper at this meeting last year; 1-8 over hurdles and rated 137; half-brother to two chase winners and dam a half-sister to high-class chaser Empire Of Dirt; acts on good ground and interesting on chase debut.
runners.comment: Useful 137 rated hurdler, point winner won bumper at this meeting in 2025, interesting

runners.name: Robbies Rock
runners.spotlight: Useful dual-purpose performer; rated 83 on the Flat; 1-6 over hurdles and rated 127; out of form on the Flat this year, however, and not bred for chasing; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Useful dual-purpose performer, out of form on Flat this year, not bred for chasing

runners.name: Eclipse Chaser
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; 1-6 over hurdles and rated 121; promising start over fences when a 2.75l third at Wexford (2m7f,gd-yld); soundly beaten over 19.5f (good) back there on latest, overlooked by Townend and this trip may be on the sharp side.
runners.comment: 0-2 over fences and rated 121, third at Wexford in May, poor latest, overlooked by Townend

runners.name: William Tell
runners.spotlight: 0-3 in point-to-points; 2-6 and rated 117 over hurdles; promising start to chasing career when runner up at Wexford; blotted copybook when unseating at the first back there on latest; probably up against it in this company.
runners.comment: Rated 117 over hurdles, good second on chase debut, unseated early on latest

runners.name: Begger
runners.spotlight: Won just one of twelve starts in point-to-points; unseated in both previous starts under Rules; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: 1-12 in points, unseated in both chase starts under Rules', others preferred

races.race_name: COLM QUINN BMW Handicap Chase

runners.name: Tell Us This
runners.spotlight: Two wins over hurdles for Gavin Cromwell; 0-7 over fences and has a tendency to jump left at times; ground conditions will suit but soundly beaten over hurdles on latest and others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Two-time hurdles winner, 0-7 over fences, can jump left at times, others appeal more

runners.name: Herja
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler yet to make much impression over the bigger obstacles; remote second at Bangor in May her best effort but soundly beaten at Hexham on latest; needs more.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler, 0-4 over fences, soundly beaten at Hexham latest, more needed

runners.name: Sea Of Doubt
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) in May and rated 8lb higher in that sphere; 0-4 over fences but has shown potential, including when a 6.5l third at Wexford in June; runner up over hurdles on latest; more needed back over fences.
runners.comment: Rated 8lb higher over hurdles, decent chase third at Wexford in June, more needed

runners.name: Truckers Cruising
runners.spotlight: Point winner scored in a handicap chase at Ayr in December (16.5f, heavy); pulled up behind Finnians Row at Downpatrick on latest; may need softer ground than this.
runners.comment: Won on heavy ground at Ayr in Dec', pulled up on latest, may need it softer
runners.owner: Ed Mulligan & John Finnegan & Aileen Saunders & Ann Holton

runners.name: Stoneyford Lady
runners.spotlight: Won off 3lb lower at Thurles (18.5f, yielding) in November; struggled on next three starts but step in right direction when a 5l third of seven at Wexford on latest (15.5f, good, jockey dropped whip after two out); eased 1lb and this longer trip more suitable.
runners.comment: Won at Thurles in November, decent third at Wexford latest, eased 1lb, moves up in trip

runners.name: Fort Randall
runners.spotlight: In excellent form since return from long layoff; won over hurdles at Kilbeggan in April; added a Cartmel handicap chase (17.5f, good) last month; this is tougher, however, so will need a career best to follow up.
runners.comment: Fine form since return from layoff, landed Cartmel handicap chase latest, this tougher

runners.name: Leave In Secret
runners.spotlight: Two-time winner over timber, including at this venue last September (16.5f, gd-yld); 0-5 over fences but hasn't run badly the last twice (trip too far on latest) and the handicapper is giving him a chance; likes it here and not dismissed.
runners.comment: Course winner over hurdles, okay chase runs last twice, h'capper relenting, not dismissed

runners.name: Stily
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; maiden in decent form in the autumn but didn't go with much enthusiasm on return from a break when pulled up at Limerick on latest; capable of better but needs to leave that behind.
runners.comment: Pulled up on return from break at Limerick, needs to leave that behind; reserve

runners.name: That's About Right
runners.spotlight: Three-time winning hurdler; 2-13 in chases, his last win coming over 2m6f (good) at Thurles in January 2025 off 9lb higher; hinted at a return to form when staying on for a remote fourth at Wexford latest (2m, good); on a dangerous mark and this longer trip will suit.
runners.comment: Hinted at a return to form at Wexford latest, 9lb below last win, longer trip here a plus

runners.name: Ned In The Park
runners.spotlight: 1-12 over hurdles; posted a solid effort on chase debut in a beginners' at Wexford (19.5f, good) last month, keeping on from the back for a 4.5l second of 14; not obviously well treated for handicap chase bow but not written off.
runners.comment: 1-12 over hurdles, promising start over fences latest, h'cap chase debut, not discounted

runners.name: Giant Haystacks
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; sent off favourite and rewarded backers with a first win over fences at Wexford (19.5f, good) on latest, beating A Snow White Park by 2.5l; 6lb higher now and steps up in grade but should go well again.
runners.comment: Up 6lb for Wexford win on latest, moves up in grade but should go well again

runners.name: Mount Shenshan
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-11 over fences; ran okay in handicap chases over further at Clonmel and Wexford earlier this year but seems best with cut in the ground; beaten 22l on good ground in a handicap hurdle on latest.
runners.comment: 0-11 over fences, seems best with cut in the ground, beaten 22l over timber latest

runners.name: Crescent Moon
runners.spotlight: Has won over hurdles but 0-8 in chases and yet to trouble the judge; beaten 33l in 2m Punchestown handicap chase on latest; drops in grade, steps up in trip and cheekpieces go on; needs more for last year's winning stable.
runners.comment: 0-8 in chases, beaten 33l on latest, drops in grade, cheekpieces on, needs more

runners.name: Kilbrin Rocco
runners.spotlight: 2-9 over fences; won off 12lb lower at Clonmel in January (2m, heavy) and off 6lb lower at Tramore (15.5f, yielding) in April; not beaten far off 2lb lower at Wexford (2m, gd-yld) on latest; return to a right-handed track a plus; stays this far and in the mix.
runners.comment: 2-9 over fences, not beaten far at Wexford latest off 2lb lower, in the mix again

runners.name: A Snow White Park
runners.spotlight: Promise in all three chase starts, including when a 2.5l second behind Giant Haystacks in a handicap at Wexford on latest despite not jumping fluently at times; nudged up 2lb and this is tougher but could go well if jumping better.
runners.comment: Promise in all three chase starts, nudged up 2lb for latest, can go well if jumps better

runners.name: My Cullen
runners.spotlight: First reserve; best run yet for this yard a 0.5l second at Kilbeggan (20.5f, good) four days ago; this shorter trip should suit on that evidence and runs off the same mark here; in the mix if getting a run.
runners.comment: Best run yet for this yard on latest, same mark here, chance if gets in; reserve

runners.name: Cahirdown Boy
runners.spotlight: Veteran; 1-18 over fences, the win coming on testing ground at Listowel in September 2024; out of form when last seen in February and remains 4lb above that last success; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Veteran, 1-18 over fences, out of form when last seen in February, others preferred

runners.name: Party President
runners.spotlight: Two-time hurdles winner; his good second over fences at Roscommon in June (16.5f, yielding) would give him a chance here but didn't back it up at Wexford and failed to fire back over hurdles at Killarney on latest.
runners.comment: Chance based on Roscommon second but poor twice since, needs to revive

runners.name: Drop A Threat
runners.spotlight: Point to point winner has yet to make much of an impact under Rules; well held in beginners' chase at Wexford on latest (behind Ned In The Park); previously pulled up in handicap chase at Tramore; in good hands but much more needed.
runners.comment: Point winner, no impact yet under rules, well held in beginners' chase latest

runners.name: Driveonwill
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; off the mark over fences in a Downpatrick beginners (19.5f, gd-yld) in May (Giant Haystacks 2.75l behind in fourth); unseated two out in handicap chase back there on latest when still in contention; can't discount off 2lb higher.
runners.comment: Still in contention when unseated in Downpatrick h'cap chase latest, up 2lb, can't dismiss

runners.name: Max Time
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; course winner over hurdles; 0-4 over fences; on long losing run and his fourth at Killarney last time was a remote one; local yard had a winner at Kilbeggan last week.
runners.comment: Course winner over hurdles, 0-4 over fences, latest fourth a remote one; reserve

runners.name: Finnians Row
runners.spotlight: 5-33 over fences and arrives on the back of successive front running 19.5f wins at Downpatrick, both on good ground; has gone up a total of 13lb but clearly in good heart and should make another bold bid here.
runners.comment: Up 13lb for successive wins at Downpatrick, in fine form, another bold bid likely

runners.name: Butter Fingers
runners.spotlight: One of three for stable; flat and hurdles winner off the mark over fences off 6lb lower at Wexford (2m, gd-yld) when last seen in May; this longer trip should be fine and yard made hay at this meeting last season; can't discount.
runners.comment: Gained first chase win at Wexford on latest, up 6lb, steps up in trip, can't discount

races.race_name: COLM QUINN BMW Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Madam Secretary
runners.spotlight: Apprentice-ridden when 5l third of eight in a maiden at Listowel in May; form of that race has been boosted by runner-up Big Negotiator; picked up valuable experience when third in a 7f maiden at Newmarket 19 days ago; winner Scommessa Secura can be rated a useful yardstick.
runners.comment: Probably does not need to improve much from her Newmarket third to open her account
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Argentarius
runners.spotlight: Finished first in a barrier trial; excellent effort in a maiden at Cork (6f, good) when beaten 1.2l into second by subsequent Group 3 winner Ballinea Star; overall form of the race is possibly suspect.
runners.comment: Second to a smart filly at Cork, the overall form of the race is possibly suspect

runners.name: Samnina
runners.spotlight: Only 1/2l behind subsequent winner Livenka when fourth on debut at the Curragh, a race won stylishly by Alpha who scrambled home at short odds in a Group 3 race at Leopardstown last week; promising.
runners.comment: Only 1/2l behind subsequent winner Livenka when fourth on debut at the Curragh, promising

runners.name: Silver Kiss
runners.spotlight: Saxon Warrior filly; made a satisfactory debut in taking third behind the well-fancied Livenka on debut at Fairyhouse; just lost second to Star Of State who has since won a Leopardstown maiden with the greatest of ease; winner's form also linked to Samnina.
runners.comment: Third behind the well-fancied Livenka at Fairyhouse, winner's form also linked to Samnina

runners.name: Suomenlinna
runners.spotlight: E350,000 yearling; sixth foal; half-sister by Too Darn Hot to three winners, including the Group-placed Villanova Queen; dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 1 (Sussex Stakes) winner Here Comes When.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Too Darn Hot to three winners, dam unraced half-sister to a Group 1 winner

runners.name: Wunderschon
runners.spotlight: 65,000gns yearling; eighth foal; sister to Group 2 winner Wonderful Moon, half-sister to four winners; trainer also runs two who have form in the book.
runners.comment: Sister to Group 2 winner Wonderful Moon, trainer also runs two who have form in the book

runners.name: Haven
runners.spotlight: 550,000gns yearling; eighth foal; Wootton Bassett filly is a half-sister to three winners, including a Group 3 scorer in France; dam a Group-placed winner by Sea The Stars, half-sister to dual French Classic winner Lope De Vega; apprentice aboard for debut.
runners.comment: By Wootton Bassett out of a half-sister to Lope De Vega, apprentice aboard for debut

runners.name: The Good Wife
runners.spotlight: E380,000 yearling; seventh foal; half-sister by Zarak to four winners; dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 2 winner Muthmir.
runners.comment: Zarak half-sister to four winners, dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 2 winner Muthmir

runners.name: Wecouldavehaditall
runners.spotlight: E52,000 yearlong, E80,000 Breeze Up; fourth foal; half-sister by Bayside Boy to a seven-time winner in France; dam was a Listed winner in France and Germany.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Bayside Boy to a seven-time winner in France, dam a Listed winner

runners.name: Dear Theodosia
runners.spotlight: 66-1, always at the back first time out in a maiden at Leopardstown 12 days ago.
runners.comment: 66-1, always at the back first time out in a maiden at Leopardstown 12 days ago

runners.name: Lunar Empress
runners.spotlight: Zoustar filly; dam 7f winner, sister to 1m2f Group 1 winner Laganore; no match for the smart Folsom Blues (subsequent Group 3 runner-up) on soft ground at Gowran in June; Shane Foley on Samnina.
runners.comment: No match for the smart Folsom Blues on debut, Shane Foley prefers Samnina

runners.name: Fine Line
runners.spotlight: Well held by Argentarius on Cork running; never involved at Leopardstown on second outing.
runners.comment: Well held by Argentarius on Cork running, never involved at Leopardstown on second outing

runners.name: Thelymitra
runners.spotlight: Stable's second-string now, as on her first two starts; will need a handicap mark.
runners.comment: Stable's second-string now, as on her first two starts. will need a handicap mark

races.race_name: COLM QUINN BMW Mile Handicap (Premier Handicap)

runners.name: Monvoe
runners.spotlight: Twice runner-up in nurseries on AW last autumn; progressive and highly dependable this season, winning three of his five races; 7lb out of the handicap, but connections are entitled to aim high given his profile; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, progress and highly dependable, aiming high here, 7lb wrong

runners.name: Far From Dandy
runners.spotlight: No win on turf since September 2024; has run well in defeat in good handicaps this season, including fourth to Ribee in Irish Lincoln; also second to stablemate Jagged Edge at Naas; below-par last time in a Curragh race dominated by Pierre Royal and Booyea; drawn low.
runners.comment: Consistent before a below-par run in a Curragh race dominated by Pierre Royal and Booyea

runners.name: Genuine Article
runners.spotlight: Only two wins from 22 Flat starts; however, he won a C&D handicap 12 months ago, and has been placed nine times; below best on seasonal debut at the Curragh in April; more like it when fifth at the same venue in May; drawn high.
runners.comment: Only two wins from 23 Flat starts, placed nine times, kept on well over 7f at Cork in May

runners.name: Lir Speciale
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a pair of heavy-ground wins at Doncaster (7f); useful form in defeat this year, in the frame in competitive York handicaps (good ground) on consecutive days last month; another good run when fifth of 17 on quick going at the same venue last time; ground-versatile, trip a worry.
runners.comment: Six-time winner at 6f/7f, solid form in defeat this term, ground-versatile, trip a worry

runners.name: Terre De Vega
runners.spotlight: Won on good ground at two in France; ran only twice for William Haggas in 2024; same last year for this stable, the best of those a second at Leopardstown on the first of two late-season handicap outings; dismal form in three subsequent outings
runners.comment: Made a promising Irish debut last October, dismal form in three subsequent outings

runners.name: Pierre Royal
runners.spotlight: Won a Gowran maiden (1m, good) for Dermot Weld last May; met trouble in running on stable/seasonal debut in a Limerick race won by Monvoe; improved from that when beating Booyea in a 1m premier handicap at the Curragh a month ago; up 9lb, might struggle to confirm form with Booyea (up 5lb).
runners.comment: Handed a 9lb rise for Curragh victory over Booyea, may struggle to uphold that form

runners.name: Lord Massusus
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner, including Listed and Group 3 races; not a bad effort (seventh behind Pierre Royal at the Curragh) on first handicap start since 2023; towards the back at Leopardstown last time; cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Has done the majority of his racing in stakes races, unplaced in two handicaps this term

runners.name: Lady Lilac
runners.spotlight: Has done most of her racing at 1m, odds-on for her sole win in a Killarney maiden last autumn; more recent form over longer distances in good company; this is closer to her optimum.
runners.comment: Has done most of her racing at 1m, more recent form over longer distances in good company

runners.name: Merlin The Wizard
runners.spotlight: Three wins in Britain in 2023 at up to 1m; regressive in 2024 and 2025 seasons; has found a new lease of life, recording back-to-back wins in a Limerick claimer and a handicap at Ballinrobe; 4lb wrong, so needs to raise his game another notch; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, has found a new lease of life, 4lb wrong so needs to raise his game again

runners.name: Hardy Warrior
runners.spotlight: Ran against smart Ballydoyle colts as a juvenile; won a three-runner 1m conditions event at Naas in March; did not quite see out the extended 1m2f when third in the Prix Noailles at Longchamp; failed to run to expectations in a valuable Gowran contest; could make a high-class handicapper, but no horse of his age has won this since 2004; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Potentially the class horse of the race, has Pattern race experience, cheekpieces added

runners.name: Kai Lung
runners.spotlight: Has failed to deliver on initial promise as a hurdler; out of his depth in top juvenile events; excuse for failure to take advantage of drop in class at Ballinrobe; won over an extended 7f in France at three; never out of the first three in six races; apart from one AW run, all Flat form on soft or worse; drawn high.
runners.comment: Has failed to deliver on initial promise as a hurdler, solid French form, suited by soft

runners.name: Jagged Edge
runners.spotlight: Won 2025 Irish Cambridgeshire for Dermot Weld, beating today's rival Genuine Article by a short head; maintained his good record in races over 1m when an emphatic winner from stablemate Far Form Dandy at Naas on seasonal/stable debut; mid-division in the Royal Hunt Cup, seventh of 20 in his group, not a bad effort.
runners.comment: Won 2025 Irish Cambridgeshire for Dermot Weld, 1m Naas winner, midfield in Royal Hunt Cup

runners.name: Howyoulikethat
runners.spotlight: Last of five wins was in 2023 when he ran well in a Group 3 at Leopardstown and a Listed contest at Killarney; not the force he was, though he has run well from time to time, including when sixth of 14 at 80-1 in this race last year; fair third at Killarney last time; valuable 5lb claimed, could go well at a decent price.
runners.comment: On a long losing sequence, ran well when sixth of 14 at 80-1 race in this race last year
runners.owner: Just The Two Of Us Partnership

runners.name: Ribee
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a terrific spell last October, notching three wins and two places during a hectic spell; maintained his rate of improvement when beating 24 rivals in the Irish Lincoln on return; early-season form also included second in a 1m2f premier handicap at the Curragh; unplaced twice in Listed races this term; handicap form gives him a leading chance; drawn low.
runners.comment: C&D winner last autumn, excellent handicap form this term, unplaced in two Listed races

runners.name: Monoceros
runners.spotlight: 10lb out of the handicap; no sign that he can add to a juvenile win at Newmarket; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, 10lb out of the handicap, no sign that he can add to a juvenile win

runners.name: Norwalk Havoc
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner at 7f/1m, the last two at Listed level over 1m on heavy ground in the Knockaire Stakes at Leopardstown, the scene of his best form; beaten only a neck in this race two years ago, tenth behind Dunum last year; drawn low.
runners.comment: Four-time winner at 7f/1m, the last two at Listed level, Leopardstown specialist

runners.name: Gleneagle Bay
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Dundalk in 2024; ran well in top handicaps last season, including third in Victoria Cup at Ascot and second in Ahonoora over 7f at this venue; has taken a while to hit form this season; opened his turf account last month at the 15th attempt; up 7lb for that 7f Cork success.
runners.comment: Opened his turf account last month at the 15th attempt, up 7lb for that 7f Cork success

runners.name: Booyea
runners.spotlight: Last win was in a valuable 1m handicap at the Curragh in June 2024; best run in almost a year when second to Pierre Royal in the same Curragh event a month ago; should come into the reckoning on that evidence, though 5lb higher now, with the winner up 9lb.
runners.comment: Last win was in June 2024, comes into the reckoning along with Pierre Royal on recent form

runners.name: Orandi
runners.spotlight: Won the Irish Lincoln last season; attempted to bring off the double at Doncaster and produced a fine effort to finish third of 22 behind Godwinson; has failed to prosper since third to Dunum in this last year; however, he is 8lb lower now and should be at peak fitness after a Curragh prep-run in a race dominated by Pierre Royal and Booyea.
runners.comment: Has failed to prosper since third in this last year but could be interesting off 8lb lower

runners.name: Dunum
runners.spotlight: Completed a four-timer when winning a 7f handicap here in 2022; won the 7f Ahonoora Handicap at the 2023 festival; made it three from six at this venue (also placed three times) when winning this event last year; third in the Ahonoora later that week; absent since last September; stiff task against that background, despite his liking for the track.
runners.comment: Won this event last year, third in a big 7f handicap later that week, seasonal debut now

races.race_name: caulfieldindustrial.com Handicap

runners.name: Inishfallen
runners.spotlight: Only one win from 27 starts and that was on AW for Brian Meehan in 2023; fair AW form early this year and showed that a turf win could be within his range when second to Dancing Saxon at Limerick last time; form given a big boost by the winner in a Listed race; handicap mark reduced by a stone over the past 12 months; may come good now from low draw..
runners.comment: Back to form when second to Dancing Saxon at Limerick, winner has given form a big boost
runners.owner: F J Carragher/Yorkavenue Syndicate/Park Ave Syndicate

runners.name: Great Mover
runners.spotlight: Only win from 23 starts came on heavy ground at Gowran last September; failed to retrieve her best form in her first four outings this term; placed twice (7f/1m1f) at Leopardstown since then, both races run on soft; stamina stretched by 1m2f at the Curragh a month ago.
runners.comment: Best form this season on soft ground, 1-23 record does not inspire confidence

runners.name: Alfred Tennyson
runners.spotlight: 7f maiden winner at Limerick last season on his sixth and final start for Aidan O'Brien; went close in a 6f handicap at Navan four three starts ago; more recent form is much less encouraging.
runners.comment: Went close in a 6f handicap four starts ago, more recent form is much less encouraging

runners.name: It'sneverjustone
runners.spotlight: Only one pound higher than when winning at last year's festival; had the same high draw then, so should not be ruled out; has to bounce back from a below-par Salisbury run; previous fourth placings at Doncaster and Thirsk were respectable; had the same high draw last year.
runners.comment: Only one pound higher than when winning at last year's festival, had the same high draw
runners.owner: Ian O'Connor & The Fox And Hounds

runners.name: Vlhova
runners.spotlight: Consistent form last year; won at Killarney's July fixture and ended the campaign with seconds at Leopardstown and Dundalk; raced too keenly when stepped up in trip on reappearance at Roscommon a month ago; probably best at 1m.
runners.comment: Held her form after joining this stable last autumn, raced too keenly on reappearance

runners.name: Send Harry
runners.spotlight: First reserve; only win from 17 starts came on AW; placed seven times, including a pleasing return to form when second in a 7f handicap at Leopardstown on his penultimate start; flattered by proximity to the smart Dancing Saxon last time.
runners.comment: First reserve, flattered by proximity to the smart Dancing Saxon last time, turf maiden

runners.name: Goal Exceeded
runners.spotlight: Good second at Leopardstown on seasonal debut; race may have come too soon at the Curragh four days later; solid third at Cork next time; hard task now having been raised 9lb for beating Send Harry at Leopardstown; unplaced in this race last year.
runners.comment: Handed a 9lb rise for beating Send Harry at Leopardstown, unplaced in this race last year
runners.owner: B White & M W White & D Sheridan & Ms H McGuinness

runners.name: Heliogabalus
runners.spotlight: Gained second win of career over 1m at Leopardstown on seasonal return last month, beating Zaraahmando by a neck; went up 8lb for that, and Zaraahmando turned the tables last time.
runners.comment: Narrow winner from Zaraahmando on seasonal debut, that rival reversed form last time

runners.name: Mehman
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner, sole turf success came in 5f handicap at Naas in May 2024; solid effort over 1m at Bellewstown in April and backed that up with a close third over 6f at Naas; a long way below his best at Leopardstown on latest.
runners.comment: Modest turf record (1-22), twice placed in the spring, a long way below his best on latest

runners.name: Shoot To Kill
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner, latest in Gowran claimer nearly a year ago; 0-10 for current yard; best form this season represented by Down Royal second in May and third at Fairyhouse early this month, both over this trip.
runners.comment: Prolific winner, has done plenty of racing since a claiming race success last August

runners.name: Sommelier
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner; highlight of British form when second to Big Evs in a Listed race at York in May 2024; rated 99 at his peak. gained his first turf success off 72 when making all in a 20-runner contest at the Curragh three starts ago; now 10lb higher.
runners.comment: Now 10lb higher than for Curragh win three starts ago, in rear over 6f on latest

runners.name: Eddie G
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins last year; opened his turf account at the 15th attempt at Naas last week; one of three for the stable here; could feature with the champion jockey booked; draw should help.
runners.comment: Two AW wins, opened his turf account at the 15th attempt at Naas last week, could feature

runners.name: Banner Beauty
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; won a Leopardstown maiden early last season; poor form in handicaps; up against it.
runners.comment: Third reserve, Leopardstown maiden winner, poor form in handicaps, up against it
runners.owner: O B P Carroll & Anthony Vaughan

runners.name: Dragon Of Malta
runners.spotlight: Has recorded three of his seven wins at Listowel and also twice successful over C&D; out of form before signs of a revival at Limerick last month; still looks risky.
runners.comment: Has won twice over C&D, out of form before signs of a revival at Limerick last month

runners.name: Red Hugh O'Donnell
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over 1m at Killarney; won a maiden there last summer (yielding to soft) and returned there a year later to record a first handicap success (good); finished 1 3/4l behind Zaraahmando when fourth at Gowran last Saturday.
runners.comment: Killarney winner, finished 1 3/4l behind Zaraahmando when fourth at Gowran last Saturday

runners.name: Go Athletico
runners.spotlight: Nine-time turf winner, including a 6f Group 3 in 2023; has also won at Listed level and was once rated 108, so has dropped a long way; inconsistent in recent years; has run well in two sprint handicaps at the Curragh lately.
runners.comment: Smart is his prime, inconsistent in recent years, has run well in sprint handicaps lately

runners.name: Summer Snow
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; won this race last year during a fine spell of form that yielded three wins; yet to hit form this season.
runners.comment: Second reserve, won this race last year during a fine spell, yet to hit form this season

races.race_name: Caulfield Industrial Irish EBF Maiden

runners.name: Sindagan
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in making the frame in two starts last autumn; placed in three 7f maidens this term; beaten favourite when second at Naas on seasonal debut; eased up late for third at Gowran; rated 83 before chasing home the long odds-on Bamako Beach at Fairyhouse; 13lb rise to 96 may flatter him; obvious chance all the same.
runners.comment: Stands out here on official figures, obvious chance but possibly flattered by his new mark
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Punica Granatum
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in 7f maidens at the Curragh and Gowran on her first two starts; faced a tough task in the Goffs Million; strong form when a short head second to subsequent Sandringham winner Green Carrera in a 1m handicap at the Curragh on seasonal debut; a long way below that form over 1m1f at the same venue last time.
runners.comment: Good chance on her Curragh run behind a Royal Ascot winner, poor over 1m1f last time

runners.name: Almeiyda
runners.spotlight: Fair fourth over 1m at Leopardstown on the second of two starts at two; appeared not to see out the extended 1m1f at Gowran on return; better when going close over an extended 7f at Roscommon; should be able to win an average maiden; tough task here against Sindagan, a high-rated gelding in the same colours.
runners.comment: 77-rated filly, can win a maiden, tough task against 96-rated Sindagan in the same colours
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Starborn Legend
runners.spotlight: E29,000 Y, E330,000 Breeze Up purchase; had a run in a barrier trial but still looked a bit raw when sixth in an 18-runner contest at the Curragh in early June; confirmed promise when a clear second behind an 82-rated rival in a 6f maiden on second start.
runners.comment: A clear second behind an 82-rated rival in a 6f maiden at the Curragh, strong chance

runners.name: Caislean Ni Cuan
runners.spotlight: Promising start in 7f maiden at Leopardstown in May, fourth of nine despite racing a shade keenly; again keen and got outpaced over the same trip at the Curragh ten days ago; unlikely to be good enough.
runners.comment: Needs to settle better on the evidence of her first two starts, unlikely to be good enough

runners.name: Brigids Charm
runners.spotlight: Elzaam filly is the first foal out of a mare who was unplaced over a range of distances; no appeal.
runners.comment: Elzaam filly, dam was unplaced over a range of distances, no appeal

runners.name: Shelton Spring
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Arizona filly, dam of little account but half-sister to two winning hurdlers.
runners.comment: Third foal, Arizona filly, dam of little account but half-sister to two winning hurdlers

runners.name: Susie's Angel
runners.spotlight: E50,000 yearling (bought in for E75,000 at a Breeze Up last year); sixth foal; half-sister to winners, best of them Asad Zabeel (five races and Listed-placed); dam French middle-distance winner.
runners.comment: Half-sister to Asad Zabeel (five wins, Listed-placed); dam French middle-distance winner

runners.name: Howya Pal
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother by Alkumait to two Italian winners and a winning hurdler; dam 1m AW winner, half-sister to an Italian Group-placed winner.
runners.comment: Half-brother by Almukait to two Italian winners and a winning hurdler, dam 1m AW winner,

runners.name: Rock Of The Daw
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam 5f AW winner, out of a half-sister to a 1m2f Listed winner and to the dam of Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Gaelic Warrior; 4yo Buratino gelding makes belated debut.
runners.comment: Dam 5f AW winner out of a half-sister to the dam of Gaelic Warrior, belated debut

runners.name: Uncle Goalie
runners.spotlight: Respectable first outing when fourth in a 1m Gowran maiden won by a stablemate of Sindagan; form of that race has been well-advertised by runner-up Loughrea.
runners.comment: Respectable first outing when fourth in a 1m Gowran maiden, runner-up has boosted the form

runners.name: Iryna's Star
runners.spotlight: Low-rated filly; did most of her racing for her previous trainer at Dundalk; never a threat in a handicap at Limerick on stable debut; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, low-rated filly, never a threat in a handicap at Limerick on stable debut

runners.name: Spinola Bear
runners.spotlight: 66-1, looked very raw at the Curragh, when finishing in rear in the race in which Starborn Legend was second.
runners.comment: 66-1, looked very raw at the Curragh, in rear in race in which Starborn Legend was second

runners.name: Winston's Promise
runners.spotlight: Beaten in excess of 15l in maidens at Limerick and Killarney; up against it.
runners.comment: Beaten in excess of 15l in maidens at Limerick and Killarney, up against it.

runners.name: Pettus Bridge
runners.spotlight: Debut was over 1m4f; down the field in 7f Fairyhouse race in which Sindagan was second.
runners.comment: Debut was over 1m4f, down the field in 7f Fairyhouse race in which Sindagan was second

runners.name: Sarfarcat
runners.spotlight: Has finished in front of only two of her 29 rivals in three outings at Dundalk; can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Has finished in front of only two of her 29 rivals in three AW outings, can be ruled out

runners.name: Tijuana
runners.spotlight: Low-rated gelding; in rear at Killarney in May on first run since 2023; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, low-rated gelding, in rear at Killarney in May on first run since 2023

races.race_name: Caulfield Industrial Handicap

runners.name: Minaun View
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; in fine form in claimers, winning back to back at Bellewstown and Killarney (both 1m, good) and runner up at Ballinrobe latest (9.5f, gd-yld); not discounted back in handicap company if getting a run.
runners.comment: In fine form in claimers, not discounted back in h'cap company if getting a run; reserve

runners.name: Liberate
runners.spotlight: Won a Goodwood novice for James Horton; gradually finding form for this yard and not beaten far at the Curragh on latest; cheekpieces now go on but she's drawn in the car park here.
runners.comment: Best effort yet for this yard on latest, cheekpieces on, drawn in the car park

runners.name: Queen Aethelflaed
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; gained second turf win at Gowran in June (1m, yielding), making all; beaten off revised mark twice since and wide draw not ideal for this front runner.
runners.comment: Beaten off revised mark twice since making all at Gowran, wide draw not ideal here

runners.name: Bucaneer's Spirit
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner; scored on seasonal return at Cork off 8lb lower; chased home Bay Of Dreams off 2lb lower at Bellewstown on penultimate; never landed a blow behind Lady Arwen at Ballinrobe on latest; visor replaces cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Won at Cork in May, never landed a blow at Ballinrobe latest, visor replaces cheekpieces

runners.name: Showyoutheropes
runners.spotlight: 1m2f winner for Tom Clover last year; best effort for this stable came at Dundalk in March; remote fourth on return from break at Tramore latest (1m4f, good); sharper for that but not sure this shorter trip will suit.
runners.comment: 1m2f winner in Britain, sharper for latest after break at Tramore, this trip a query

runners.name: Kitty Bear
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; gained second turf win at Roscommon in May (7.5f, good) off 9lb lower; soundly beaten in three runs since including off lower AW mark latest; drawn wide.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in three runs since Roscommon win in May, drawn wide
runners.owner: Charles Kerwin & Brendan Kerwin & Liam Kehoe

runners.name: Elusive Duke
runners.spotlight: First reserve; runner up in three of last four starts; chased home Lady Arwen at Ballinrobe on latest (9.5f, good); remains 7lb above sole success so needs to find a bit extra to get his head back in front; place chance.
runners.comment: Runner up three of last four starts, place shout but needs more to win; reserve

runners.name: Dark Summit
runners.spotlight: French winner has yet to fire since joining this yard; mark is tumbling, however, and he's worth monitoring in the market now dropped in class with cheekpieces back on.
runners.comment: French winner, no show yet for this yard but worth a market check down in class

runners.name: Faoladh
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; 2-16 on turf; won over 1m at Leopardstown (good) last season off 66; scored at Down Royal (7f, good) off 67 in May and just 1lb higher here but in poor form since and needs to revive in new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Below best since 7f win at Down Royal in May off 1lb lower, needs to revive

runners.name: Ballymagreehan
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; AW winner scored over 1m at Gowran in May (good); hit with a 10lb hike for that and has come up short in both starts since; others look better treated.
runners.comment: Anchored by 10lb rise for May's Gowran win, others look better treated; reserve

runners.name: Finsceal Annie
runners.spotlight: One of two for yard; back-to-back wins at Leopardstown last summer over 7f on soft and good ground; yet to hit top form this term but is now 2lb below her last win and rider takes off another 3lb; ran poorly at this meeting last year.
runners.comment: Yet to hit form this season, 2lb below last win but ran poorly here last year

runners.name: Rhythm King
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner including here over 7f on heavy; off since a poor run here last October; is 9lb below last win but best form is on testing ground so could do with some rain.
runners.comment: Course winner over 7f, well handicapped but lacks a run and prefers soft ground

runners.name: San Aer
runners.spotlight: Two-time C&D winner on heavy off higher marks; went close again over C&D in October, again on heavy; caught the eye when short of room and not beaten far at Killarney on latest (1m, good); softer conditions would be preferable but he's got plenty of decent form on this sort of ground and his yard targets this meeting; chance.
runners.comment: Two-time C&D winner on heavy, acts on good ground too, well handicapped, chance

runners.name: Moyassr
runners.spotlight: Decent strike rate on the AW (4-10) but just 1-16 on turf; that win came over 1m2f (good) at Fairyhouse in May; struggled off revised mark twice since and wide draw to overcome here.
runners.comment: 4-10 on AW, 1-16 on turf, struggled off revised mark since Fairyhouse win, drawn wide

runners.name: Grey Leader
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D at this meeting in 2024 off 15lb higher; that win came on yielding and his last win came on heavy so while well handicapped, could probably do with a drop of rain.
runners.comment: C&D winner off 15lb higher, well-handicapped but rain would enhance claims

runners.name: Cala Bonita
runners.spotlight: 2-5 on the AW; won on turf at Gowran last season (1m, good) off 12lb lower; moderate efforts over further the last twice and may be in handicapper's grip for now.
runners.comment: AW and turf winner, 12lb above last turf win, may be in handicapper's grip

runners.name: Bay Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: One of two for yard; AW and turf winner for James Ferguson; off the mark for this stable on latest at Bellewstown (1m, good); 8lb rise makes things tougher but this prominent racer is well drawn and can't be discounted for last year's winning yard.
runners.comment: Hiked up 8lb for Bellewstown win but prominent racer well drawn and can't discount

runners.name: Java Wood
runners.spotlight: Gained first turf win off 8lb lower at Limerick (1m, yielding) in June; narrowly denied in follow up bid two days later at Gowran (9.5f, yielding); handles good ground and top rider booked but the draw gods haven't been kind.
runners.comment: Won at Limerick, narrowly denied at Gowran, top rider booked but drawn wide here

runners.name: Blues Emperor
runners.spotlight: Five wins for Johnny Murtagh; went close for this yard at the Curragh in April (7f, soft); below best in four starts since and drawn wide here but drops in grade and is chucked in on last year's best form if rediscovering his best.
runners.comment: Five-time winner, below best recently but drops in grade and on dangerous mark now

runners.name: Lady Arwen
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner including twice this season; stayed on well to see off Elusive Duke at Ballinrobe (9.5f, gd-yld) eight days ago (Loingseoir fourth) and raised 7lb; has gone well here before but very wide draw not ideal.
runners.comment: Up 7lb for Ballinrobe win on latest, has gone well here before but drawn very wide

runners.name: Loingseoir
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner; hold up sort has run respectably in three of his last four starts; stayed on well for fourth behind Lady Arwen at Ballinrobe latest; placed at this meeting over 7f in 2022; ground versatile and could go well granted luck in running.
runners.comment: Hold up sort, good run at Ballinrobe latest, capable off this mark, could go well
runners.owner: W Keeling & M C Grassick & Mrs M J Grassick

races.race_name: Support Our Local On-Course Bookmakers Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Jazzy Bay
runners.spotlight: Run to a similar level all four starts, incuding behind Parading in a seller in May; didn't look to have any excuses on his nursery debut last time but coming back up from 6f won't hurt.
runners.comment: No excuses on his nursery debut last time but coming back up from 6f won't hurt

runners.name: Dream On Kent
runners.spotlight: Disappointing in a seller last time (second run at that level) and the visor goes back on tonight; trainer among the winners and his strike-rate with 2yos is up a touch this season but he's looking exposed now.
runners.comment: Disappointing in a seller last time and the visor goes back on tonight; looking exposed

runners.name: Drum Major
runners.spotlight: Done most racing over 5f, didn't look to see out 6f in one try, has hung both ways and is looking exposed; cheekpieces go back on and he doesn't make obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Hung both ways and is looking exposed; cheekpieces go back on; hard to fancy

runners.name: Ten Year Stretch
runners.spotlight: Trainer back among the winners and got on the board for the year with 2yos recently (nursery newcomer); he does well with juveniles here too and this filly, who ran green on debut before pulling hard second time, is open to improvement.
runners.comment: Green on debut before pulling hard second time; open to improvement and respected

runners.name: Clear Horizon
runners.spotlight: Backward step at Newbury last time but has stamina on her dam's side and the extra furlong may help now handicapping off a lowly opening mark; holds each-way claims from the outside stall.
runners.comment: Extra furlong may help now handicapping; holds each-way claims from the outside stall

runners.name: Magical Life
runners.spotlight: Not looked the easiest thus far and goes without the cheekpieces again having not seen out a stiffer 7f last time; trainer 0-27 with 2yos this season and it wouldn't say much for the others were she able to take this.
runners.comment: Not looked the easiest; wouldn't say much for the others were she able to take this

runners.name: Parading
runners.spotlight: Didn't look to enjoy the Brighton experience last time, but his small-field selling second previously didn't amount to much anyway (Jazzy Bay third); trainer does much better with 2yos on the AW than turf and he'll need to improve now handicapping.
runners.comment: Didn't look to enjoy the Brighton experience last time; needs to improve now handicapping

runners.name: Cutlass
runners.spotlight: Nothing exciting in three 6f starts round Windsor, latterly when said to have hung left late on; stable having a quiet year thus far (0-23 with 2yos) and he'll need to improve for the extra furlong.
runners.comment: Stable having a quiet year (0-23 with 2yos); he'll need to improve for the extra furlong

runners.name: Emirates Express
runners.spotlight: Big prices for three runs to date (5f-6f) last month and finished a well-beaten last each time; trainer 0-24 with 2yos for the season and a shock were he the one to put him on the board.
runners.comment: Trainer 0-24 with 2yos for the season and a shock were he the one to put him on the board

runners.name: Ariane Sky
runners.spotlight: Showed enough in three runs in the spring to think she can be a factor at this level now handicapping; goes on the shortlist for her much in-form trainer.
runners.comment: Enough in three runs in spring to think she can be a factor at this level now handicapping

races.race_name: DragonBet/Martin Davies Handicap

runners.name: Flyta
runners.spotlight: Starman filly who is much improved of late, building on Windsor second with breakthrough success in seven-runner handicap over C&D 29 days ago; up 3lb but she merits serious consideration.
runners.comment: Much improved of late, breakthrough success over C&D latest; merits serious consideration

runners.name: Distinct Spirit
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut in 7f Salsibury novice in July 2024; lightly raced since but has posted good third placings in 1m handicaps at Newbury and Yarmouth this summer; very much one to consider off same mark.
runners.comment: Good third placings in 1m handicaps at Newbury and Yarmouth this summer; considered

runners.name: Sofian
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at the ninth attempt over C&D last August; yet to hit top form this summer, although saddle reportedly slipped when sixth of eight over C&D four weeks ago; not out of things.
runners.comment: C&D winner last August; saddle slipped when sixth over C&D four weeks ago; not ruled out

runners.name: Name The Day
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win at the third attempt in 7f Chepstow maiden in July; last of ten on handicap debut at Newbury (1m) 11 days ago; lots more is needed in a first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Last on handicap debut at Newbury 11 days ago; lots more needed in a first-time tongue-tie

races.race_name: Cymru Bet/Alan Bushell Racing Classified Stakes

runners.name: King Of The Dance
runners.spotlight: Hampered and unseated on latest start; second in a 7.3f classified here the time before and had a turf win last July, with plenty of occasions too in which he's not been far away, so has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Had a turf win last July, with plenty of occasions too in which he's not been far away

runners.name: Knightmare
runners.spotlight: 0-21 before he won a classified at Chepstow (1m, good to firm) four days ago; he'd been knocking on the door with four seconds in his preceding five races this summer, including twice after six-day absences; concedes 5lb all round today but most of the others have been struggling.
runners.comment: 0-21 before Chepstow classified win (1m) four days ago; he'd been knocking on the door

runners.name: Cezarro
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden who has some modest form (mostly on AW) but was beaten 38l and 30l this month in his two starts for new stable; at least this drop back in trip looks a plus.
runners.comment: 16-race maiden who has some modest form but was beaten 38l and 30l in two runs this month

runners.name: Lhebayeb
runners.spotlight: Three wins in an industrious 2025 and another this March; three of those were AW, as was the respectable show in first-time cheekpieces on latest start, while last June's 1m classified win at Chepstow was on soft; others look more solid these days on today's likely good or good to firm ground.
runners.comment: Has form and wins but others look more solid these days on good or good to firm ground

runners.name: Mooretown Lad
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish (1m1f winner in 2024); running for this yard since December and the odd piece of that form gives him a shout, including penultimate start but that was on soft ground; below form sole start on firmer than good.
runners.comment: 2nd on penultimate start but that was on soft; below form sole start on firmer than good

runners.name: Create
runners.spotlight: Still capable of modest form on occasions last year, including two 1m wins on Southwell AW, but competitive only once (penultimate start) in 2026.
runners.comment: Modest form on occasions last year; competitive only once (penultimate start) in 2026
runners.owner: Dixon, Wylam, M Baldry, J&s Harrod

runners.name: Prophet Squeeze
runners.spotlight: Hasn't shown much over jumps and same story this year switched to the Flat; keeps being slowly away and refused to race here on penultimate appearance, admittedly without her usual hood, but still hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Hasn't shown much over jumps and it's been the same story this year switched to the Flat

races.race_name: Christian Holland/Ken Howell Sports Betting Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Summerson
runners.spotlight: Hood both starts; second of eight at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) and second of three at Chester (1m2f, good) in another maiden; not bred for this far but the same was true last time when she again did her best work at the finish.
runners.comment: Two 2nds; not bred for this far but same was true at 1m2f when she did best work late on

runners.name: Seacole
runners.spotlight: 400,000gns yearling; second in a three-runner novice at Nottingham (1m2f, good) in June, behind a long odds-on favourite, and set the pace when fourth of six in a maiden at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) 18 days later; hooded for both; that's fair form, among the best in this field, and pedigree gives her a good chance to stay 1m4f.
runners.comment: Fair form is among the best in this and pedigree gives her a good chance to stay 1m4f

runners.name: Cracking Beauty
runners.spotlight: 11th of 14 on debut at Lingfield (7f, AW) in November but spectacularly outran odds of 125-1 when third of 12 in a novice at Kempton (1m3f, AW) three weeks ago, nearly taking second; switches to turf but she's in the same ballpark on ratings as the best two of these.
runners.comment: Outran odds of 125-1 when third of 12 in a novice at Kempton (1m3f, AW) three weeks ago

runners.name: Khepri
runners.spotlight: Set the pace when last of four at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) and ran on from the rear when fourth of ten in a maiden at Pontefract (1m2f, good; 40-1) 17 days later; the latter showed promise but further improvement is needed against all three of today's rivals.
runners.comment: Ran on from the rear when fourth of ten in Pontefract maiden (1m2f, good; 40-1) last time

races.race_name: Alan Bennett Racing/Keith Davies Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Just Adair
runners.spotlight: Four defeats at short prices off this sort of mark since two Windsor wins late last summer; didn't look to love the Epsom experience last time, though, and will rightly be popular again; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Didn't look to love the Epsom experience last time and will rightly be popular again

runners.name: Pureis King
runners.spotlight: His 0-50 classified win here last month has been well advertised since and he just did enough back into a handicap at Leicester (1m4f) last time, despite hanging left on good to firm ground; up 3lb with good chance of the hat-trick.
runners.comment: Subsequent winners behind when winning last two; good chance of the hat-trick upped 3lb

runners.name: Buck Barrow
runners.spotlight: Goes well here and took advantage of the drop to 0-50 classified company when winning a weak race over C&D early last month; ran at least as well back into handicap company here four weeks ago to confirm himself still in good form.
runners.comment: Likes it here and arrives in good form; holds each-way claims in a competitive affair

runners.name: Virtual Hug
runners.spotlight: Held a couple of times round his beloved Bath in 0-55 company since winning from Bobby Dassler there in the spring; usually dropped in and will want a decent test round this easier course.
runners.comment: Held a couple of times round his beloved Bath in 0-55 company lately; wants a good test
runners.owner: Mike Harris Racing & Nikki Evans Racing

runners.name: Bobby Dassler
runners.spotlight: Has done a lot of his racing at 1m and has often pulled hard when going further, including in the hood (back on tonight; tongue-tie comes off) but does stay this far; not much room for manoeuvre off this mark and needs to leave two lesser efforts behind.
runners.comment: Hard-puller; little room for manoeuvre off this mark; has to leave two lesser runs behind

runners.name: Zaraquelle
runners.spotlight: Strong in the market on comeback from almost a year off early in the month, when the race didn't set up ideally, and duly won a 1m6f amateurs' handicap on Wolverhampton Tapeta last Tuesday; fair claims under a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Won an amateurs' handicap on Tapeta last Tuesday; holds fair claims under a 5lb penalty

runners.name: Trojan Truth
runners.spotlight: Hold-up performer who's odds-on to blow the start; landed a hat-trick last summer over about this trip on good to firm ground, latterly off a 1lb higher mark, but not as consistent this time round; needs more.
runners.comment: Hat-trick last summer but not as consistent this time round; needs more

runners.name: Miners Cabin
runners.spotlight: Irish trainer 14-51 with Flat runners brought over, which entitles this 4yo to some respect; it's hard to find any other positives, though, with him yet to get involved in a finish under either code; the market will likely tell a tale.
runners.comment: Irish trainer 14-51 with Flat runners brought over; the market will likely tell a tale

runners.name: Noble Grace
runners.spotlight: Went close in a bumper on her debut last spring before not taking to hurdles; well held in three Flat runs this season but this task is more realistic now handicapping and she's one to track in the market.
runners.comment: This task is more realistic now handicapping and she's one to track in the market

races.race_name: Jack Bevan & Co/Pinno Bookmakers Handicap

runners.name: Legendsoftheland
runners.spotlight: No problem with 7f and found the drop to 5f against him last month, when again running well off this mark; stable among the winners and he's high on the shortlist back up in trip.
runners.comment: Drop to 5f against him last month, when again running well off this mark; shortlisted

runners.name: Honour Your Dreams
runners.spotlight: Winner over this trip but doesn't run over it often now, all starts this year having come over 5f; continues to tumble down the weights but has struggled in two runs back on turf latterly and others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Continues to tumble down the weights but has struggled in two runs back on turf latterly

runners.name: Barry The Worm
runners.spotlight: Closed out last year with a Tapeta win in first-time cheekpieces off 2lb higher; struggled this time round and will need to improve somewhat on previous turf efforts.
runners.comment: Struggled this time round and will need to improve somewhat on previous turf efforts

runners.name: Smasher
runners.spotlight: Wins have all come after a recent outing and he's having just a second ever run on turf, in a first-time tongue-tie; it's therefore hard to say that everything looks in place for a big run, for a yard also responsible for Honour Your Dreams.
runners.comment: Wins have all come after a recent outing and he's having just a second ever run on turf

runners.name: Macarone
runners.spotlight: Wins for two previous yards came in the autumn, mainly on the AW, and he's regressed in recent times; the step back up from 5f is a plus off a career-low mark, though, for a trainer who holds more obvious claims with Symbol Of Hope.
runners.comment: Regressed in recent times; the step back up from 5f is a plus off a career-low mark though

runners.name: My Mate Beattie
runners.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who's overall continued to regress this year, mainly over 7f; has been offering a bit more again of late, without having the breaks, but others look stronger.
runners.comment: Offering a bit more again of late, without having the breaks, but others look stronger

runners.name: Haworth Star
runners.spotlight: Best efforts have all come on Tapeta and he's struggled in both runs this season, having regressed last year; not easy to make a case for him.
runners.comment: Best efforts have all come on Tapeta and he's struggled in both runs this season

runners.name: Aplaceinthesun
runners.spotlight: New trainer won with six of his last 12 runners and is 4-12 with runners here; that's where the positives end, as she showed little for two previous yards (6f-1m) before being picked up for 900gns early last month; watch the market.
runners.comment: New trainer won with six of his last 12 runners; showed little to date; watch the market

runners.name: Symbol Of Hope
runners.spotlight: Two years since he last won and five years since he won away from his beloved Bath; one of his better efforts there last time but he is no certainty to reproduce it back up in trip (can pull hard these days).
runners.comment: One of his better efforts at his beloved Bath latest but no certainty to reproduce it

runners.name: Diamondsinthesand
runners.spotlight: Three wins and three seconds from eight runs here and he will be happier sprinting again having not seen out 1m last month; time has looked to be catching up this year, however, and Legendsoftheland appears his trainer's best chance.
runners.comment: Three wins and three seconds from eight runs here but time looks to be catching up
